description:
Step into a world of performance and creativity as you prepare for a dynamic career across stage and screen. This practical and skill intensive boutique program is offered to a small number of high-quality performers and is designed around four key pillars:

  • core craft
  • context
  • repertoire
  • industry engagement. 

You'll receive world-class training and access to a network of industry professionals who can support your growth as a performer. If you're ready to unlock your imagination, build resilience and nurture your curiosity, this is the degree for you.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Acting
  • Undertake intensive training in acting, voice and speech, singing, movement and dance, building a versatile performance skillset.
  • Develop your artistic identity in a supportive environment, combining ensemble work, collaborative laboratories and industry-led workshops. 
  • Perform in fully staged productions with live audiences, refining your craft and stage presence. 
  • At one of Australia's leading music and performing arts schools, you'll learn from award-winning educators and internationally recognised performers, benefiting from our global connections.
  • Work with Griffith Film School on major performance projects to gain experience both in front of and behind the camera.
Connect with Queensland's arts scene

Studying in Brisbane's South Bank precinct means you'll have an exclusive stage-door pass, placing you at the heart of Queensland's thriving cultural scene. You may have the opportunity to work with leading industry organisations including QPAC, Queensland Theatre and Brisbane Festival.

description:
Queensland's #1 university for both AI research and economics. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Unlock your potential with a flexible business degree built for today's fast-changing marketplace. Our online, on-demand Bachelor of Business gives you the freedom to shape your study around your interests, career goals and lifestyle. You'll build core business skills, explore what drives modern organisations and graduate with the knowledge and confidence to lead in a world that values adaptability, innovation and purpose.

This degree offers an exploration of the forces that shape the business world, from entrepreneurship and economic trends to legal systems and government policy. You'll learn how external and internal environments influence how organisations operate, compete, and grow. By understanding the broader context in which businesses function, you'll be equipped to assess risks, spot emerging opportunities, and make sound strategic decisions that contribute to organisational success across a range of industries.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Business 
  • Study 100% online, on demand. Start when you're ready, set your own pace and pause if you need to.
  • Tailor your study to suit your interests and career goals, with a wide range of elective options and the ability to choose a major after you've started your studies, you don't have to decide right away. Once you've had time to explore your options, you can either continue without a specialisation or choose from majors in Business Analytics, Management, or Marketing.
  • Build adaptable skills in communication, strategy, leadership and problem-solving.
  • Learn the fundamentals of business and apply them to real-world challenges, guided by principles of sustainability, inclusion and equity.
  • Be supported with interactive activities, academic and student services and flexible study options designed to fit your life and give you a complete view of business strategy.
  • Graduate ready to pursue a wide range of career opportunities or continue into specialist postgraduate study.

This degree is part of Griffith GO, our 100% online, on-demand degrees that let you start when you're ready, study at your own pace and learn from anywhere.

description:
The Doctor of Clinical Dentistry is suitable for qualified dentists seeking to advance their expertise in the specialised fields of Endodontics or Periodontics.

This program offers a comprehensive blend of clinical training, academic coursework and research, aiming to cultivate highly skilled specialists capable of delivering advanced patient care.

Highlights of studying the Doctor of Clinical Dentistry
  • Engage in rigorous clinical practice, honing your ability to manage complex cases and perform specialised procedures.
  • In Endodontics, you will master techniques for diagnosing and treating diseases of the tooth pulp and surrounding tissues.
  • In Periodontics, the focus is on the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of periodontal diseases including surgical interventions and implantology.
  • Both specialisations emphasise evidence-based approaches and the integration of the latest scientific advancements into clinical practice.

The curriculum is designed to prepare you for specialist registration, equipping you with the necessary skills to contribute to the advancement of dental science and to take on leadership roles in clinical settings.

The Doctor of Clinical Dentistry is an AQF Level 9 Masters Extended degree.

description:
Queensland's #1 university for electrical and electronic engineering. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Are you passionate about both aviation and engineering? This double degree offers the perfect combination, with two career pathways. With a focus on hands-on learning, you'll gain the technical expertise of an engineer alongside the practical skills of aviation, making you highly sought after by airlines, aerospace companies and aviation engineering organisations. Alternatively, you may choose to undertake further fully self-funded flight training with an external provider to become a qualified commercial pilot.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)/Bachelor of Aviation
  • Build a strong foundation in aviation theory, including flight planning, aerodynamics, atmospheric science and human factors while studying electronic or mechanical engineering in depth.
  • Develop skills in our flight simulation lab to gain readiness for practical pilot training.
  • Access Griffith's strong networks across aviation and engineering for internships, industry placements and career guidance.

Work at the forefront of global finance and step into the high-demand field of regulation and security. This masters degree equips you with advanced skills to detect, investigate and prevent financial crime while ensuring organisations meet complex regulatory obligations.

According to the World Economic Forum, financial crime costs the global economy trillions of dollars annually, so there's strong demand for professionals who can navigate risk, governance and compliance with confidence.

Highlights of studying the Master of Financial Crime Investigation and Compliance
  • Develop advanced knowledge of financial crime regulation, compliance and governance.
  • Build investigative skills in forensic accounting, fraud detection and financial analysis, preparing you to respond to threats such as money laundering, fraud and terrorism financing.
  • Learn to identify and mitigate risks across global financial systems.
  • Gain expertise in cyber security, data protection and digital fraud prevention.
  • Explore transnational organised crime and its links to financial systems.
  • Eligible students may receive credit for approved recognised prior study and/or relevant professional experience, so you may gain a masters in as little as one year of full-time study.

Gain a deep understanding of regulatory environments across jurisdictions and industries. You'll examine governance, policy development and reporting requirements, learning how to design and implement effective compliance strategies. With a focus on ethical practice and emerging technologies, you'll graduate ready to operate in highly regulated, data-driven environments.

Start your path toward a meaningful and rewarding career in healthcare at Australia's #1 ranked university for nursing and midwifery*. This pathway program will prepare you to transition into the Bachelor of Nursing.

The Diploma of Nursing Science introduces you to the principles and practice of professional nursing. You'll gain the strong foundation you need to succeed in your studies and future nursing career. description:
Some courses in this program are scheduled to be offered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations.

Queensland's #1 university for law and criminology. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Shape justice. Change lives. Take on the challenge of understanding both the law and the causes of crime with this powerful double degree. You'll be prepared to think critically, act ethically and make an impact on the justice system.

You'll gain a deep understanding of how laws are created, interpreted and enforced while exploring what drives criminal behaviour and how crime can be prevented. With a strong focus on practical learning, you'll build the knowledge and experience to advocate for fairness, influence policy and drive meaningful change in your community.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Laws (Honours)/Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice 
  • Learn from practising lawyers, criminologists and justice experts whose research and experience influence real legal reforms.
  • Develop essential skills in research, negotiation, advocacy and data analysis to prepare for legal and policy challenges.
  • Study contemporary topics such as criminal law, cybercrime, corrections, human rights and social justice.
  • Build a professional network through internships and mentoring programs with law firms, legal aid services and justice organisations.
  • There may be opportunities to travel overseas as part of the degree, with programs designed to connect directly to what you're studying.
Practical experience 

From your first year, you'll gain hands-on experience through mooting, professional placements and criminology projects that connect you with industry partners. Work with clients in our Griffith Legal Clinics, participate in court visits and debates and contribute to community-based crime prevention initiatives. You may even take part in the award-winning Griffith Innocence Project, a program where students work alongside lawyers to help investigate wrongful convictions and improve justice outcomes in Australia.

Industry and expert connections 

Passionate teaching experts bring insights from contemporary cases, legal reforms and justice system trends, to apply academic knowledge to real scenarios. Be immersed in authentic experiences and graduate with the networks and support to launch your career in law or criminology.

This degree prepares you for leadership and management roles across airports, airlines and aviation organisations worldwide. From airport planning and operations to aviation safety, security, human factors (how people influence aviation safety) and business data analysis, you'll gain a solid foundation in how the aviation sector works and how to manage its unique challenges. description:

  • Develop advanced skills in forensic mental health assessment, intervention and case management.
  • Explore the relationship between mental disorder and offending behaviour through evidence-based frameworks.
  • Build practical skills in treatment planning, rehabilitation and recovery-focused care and learn to work effectively with diverse and underrepresented populations in forensic settings.
  • Through applied learning and case-based scenarios, you¿ll learn to assess risk, write reports, respond to complex presentations and contribute to safer communities.

This advanced training seeks to deepen specialist skills and knowledge for effective practice.

Advance your expertise with a Master of Finance and prepare for leadership in the global finance and investment industry. Designed for ambitious graduates and professionals, this postgraduate degree delivers advanced technical knowledge, quantitative capability and strategic insight for investment analysis, portfolio management and financial risk.

Whether you're entering the finance sector or accelerating your progression in the field, this masters degree equips you with the analytical tools and professional acumen needed to succeed in competitive financial markets.

Highlights of studying the Master of Finance
  • Develop advanced skills in investment analysis, asset valuation and portfolio management.
  • Master derivatives, risk management and fixed income markets.
  • Build expertise in equity markets and alternative investments.
  • Strengthen your quantitative analysis and business analytics capability.
  • Study progression aligned to global professional benchmarks including Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®), Financial Risk Manager (FRM®) and Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA®) curricula and examinations.
  • Flexible study options, including online study, mean you can balance postgraduate education with professional commitments.
  • You may be eligible for credit for recognised prior study or work experience, allowing you to complete your degree in as little as one year full-time. See entry requirements below.
Build advanced financial and investment expertise

Gain comprehensive preparation in corporate finance, investments and financial markets. You'll apply financial theory and quantitative techniques to real investment decisions. You'll analyse and evaluate equities, fixed income securities, derivatives and alternative assets across international capital markets.

Develop deep expertise in portfolio construction, performance evaluation and active management strategies while building a strong understanding of market efficiency, risk and return. Through advanced study in derivatives and risk management, you'll examine pricing models, hedging strategies and credit risk analysis to support informed financial decision-making.

You'll also strengthen your capability in business analytics and quantitative tools, using statistical and data-driven approaches to interpret complex financial information. With a dedicated focus on ethics and professional standards aligned to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics, you will graduate with a strong appreciation of integrity, accountability and responsible investment practice.

Build advanced expertise in global legal systems and gain the skills to navigate complex international challenges. The Master of International Law prepares graduates and professionals to engage with legal issues that cross borders, from international trade and environmental protection to human rights and dispute resolution. In our interconnected world, governments, organisations and businesses require professionals who understand international legal frameworks and how they operate in practice.

Highlights of studying the Master of International Law
  • Develop advanced knowledge of international law and the legal systems that govern global relations.
  • Examine critical global issues through courses in international human rights law, environmental law and international criminal law.
  • Build expertise in cross-border negotiation, international dispute resolution and commercial arbitration.
  • Explore legal frameworks that influence international trade, intellectual property and global business activity.
  • On-campus students learn on the iconic Gold Coast with a thriving collegiate community.
  • Broaden your perspective through global mobility programs, including short-term international study experiences or exchange opportunities that expose you to different legal systems and global perspectives.
  • Eligible students may receive credit for recognised prior study or professional experience, so you may gain a masters qualification in as little as one year of full-time study.
Learn from the best

Our experienced international law experts have connections to global organisations such as the United Nations, international arbitral tribunals, the Hague Academy of International Law (including the Conference on Private International Law), major global law firms, the Australian government, international businesses and international civil society organisations.

You'll also benefit from work-integrated learning opportunities, including within international and intergovernmental organisations, as well as international courts, global law firms and businesses.

For students interested in deeper research, a supervised thesis option provides the opportunity to explore a specialised area of international law while strengthening your research and analytical capability.

description:
This degree equips you with the technical expertise and creative skill to design and manufacture custom-made dental devices that enhance oral health and function. Dental technologists (or dental technicians as they are often referred to) are highly skilled members of the dental team.

This is an ideal degree if you have an eye for detail and an artistic or scientific background. Graduates work behind the scenes to create and manufacture dentures, crowns, bridges and orthodontic appliances in both conventional and digital contexts.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Dental Technology
  • Combine art and science to create custom-made dental devices that restore function and appearance.
  • Learn foundational health science and prosthetic principles, then progress to advanced dental laboratory techniques.
  • Gain experience with industry-standard CAD/CAM technology, including milling and 3D printing.
  • Work with a wide range of materials such as gold, porcelain, lost wax, and acrylic, and learn to record precise details like tooth colour and shape.
  • Study human anatomy in our Anatomy Lab with real specimens to deepen your understanding of dental and facial structures.
Work with advanced technology in professional settings  

Develop professional experience through practical work-integrated learning in your third year and placements in commercial dental laboratories. Learn alongside dentistry students in our world-class dental clinics featuring 117 modern chairs and over 6,000 patient appointments each year.

Whether your interests lie in the artistry of aesthetic design or the technical challenge of advanced dental materials and technologies, this degree offers a pathway to a rewarding and in-demand profession.

Honours

The Bachelor of Dental Technology (Honours) (2127) is available for students who want to advance their education through original research and deepen their expertise in dental technology.

This degree equips you with the technical expertise and creative skill to design and manufacture custom-made dental devices that enhance oral health and function. Dental technologists (or dental technicians as they are often referred to) are highly skilled members of the dental team.

This is an ideal degree if you have an eye for detail and an artistic or scientific background. Graduates work behind the scenes to create and manufacture dentures, crowns, bridges and orthodontic appliances in both conventional and digital contexts.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Dental Technology
  • Combine art and science to create custom-made dental devices that restore function and appearance.
  • Learn foundational health science and prosthetic principles, then progress to advanced dental laboratory techniques.
  • Gain experience with industry-standard CAD/CAM technology, including milling and 3D printing.
  • Work with a wide range of materials such as gold, porcelain, lost wax, and acrylic, and learn to record precise details like tooth colour and shape.
  • Study human anatomy in our Anatomy Lab with real specimens to deepen your understanding of dental and facial structures.
Work with advanced technology in professional settings  

Develop professional experience through practical work-integrated learning in your third year and placements in commercial dental laboratories. Learn alongside dentistry students in our world-class dental clinics featuring 117 modern chairs and over 6,000 patient appointments each year.

Whether your interests lie in the artistry of aesthetic design or the technical challenge of advanced dental materials and technologies, this degree offers a pathway to a rewarding and in-demand profession.

Graduates of Griffith University's Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) degree have a competitive edge as they are equipped with practical skills, experience and attributes that employers value, coupled with highly developed research capabilities.

Offered by Griffith University's School of Nursing and Midwifery, our Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) will give you an opportunity to undertake advanced study and supervised research work.

You'll complete coursework and a research preparation course in your first trimester and complete a dissertation in your second trimester.

Coursework
Through the 30-credit point coursework component of the Honours program, you'll gain an understanding of how to critically evaluate research. You'll also develop your knowledge of statistical analysis techniques as applied to scientific research and gain an awareness of how research proposals should be designed.

Dissertation
Through the 50-credit point dissertation component, you'll conduct research on a specific project and complete a seminar and dissertation describing the research in detail.

You'll be required to find a suitable supervisor for your research project prior to submitting your application for admission into the Honours program. If you are unable to find a suitable supervisor, you should discuss your proposed research project with the Program Director.

description:
The games industry is growing and evolving at an extraordinary rate. This degree is designed to equip you with the complex skills you'll need for a successful career conceptualising and creating the next wave of games and virtual worlds.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Game Design and Production
  • Work individually and in teams on projects that meet commercial standards, collaborating with multidisciplinary creatives with a wide range of production skills and expertise.
  • Access an exciting calendar of exhibitions, guest lectures and masterclasses.
  • Learn from some of the country's leading designers, who are already pushing the boundaries of game design and creative arts.
  • Connect with designers, filmmakers, animators, illustrators and musicians across Griffith's various creative schools.
  • Engage with practitioners and gain hands-on experience working on game design projects for real clients through our commercial multimedia production arm, LiveLab.
Build your network and skills 

Develop vital contacts and networks through our local and global industry links with leading organisations like Epic Games, Toon Boom, Liquid Animation, Animal Logic, NEP, Asia Pacific Screen Academy, Ludo (Bluey) and Cutting Edge.

Become part of the industry

Griffith University is an official Unreal Academic Partner, giving you access to the powerful Unreal Engine used for high-fidelity games and virtual production. We are also a member of the Interactive Games and Entertainment Association (IGEA), connecting you with the games industry across Australia and New Zealand.

Majors

You'll choose a specialisation, while also having the freedom to explore contemporary developments in the practice of interactive game design and related disciplines. Gain essential knowledge and studio experience in areas like:

Virtual production and VFX: Discover how to create engaging, dynamic content with virtual production and its innovative methods, including motion capture, LED wall technology, photogrammetry, camera tracking and virtual lighting through real-time game engines. You'll learn to use these tools to produce immersive, visually striking worlds that blend physical and digital elements seamlessly, so you can take part in revolutionising how we create and experience media.

3D art and environments: Learn to interpret visual concepts and artistic styles to create appealing 3D characters, props, vehicles and environments for games, film and animation. Using industry-standard tools and cutting-edge technology, you'll develop skills in modelling, texturing, lighting, and rendering to create assets that inspire and immerse. This area of study combines artistry with technical precision, giving you the ability to craft visually compelling experiences that resonate with audiences on an emotional and narrative level.

Gameplay programming: Through practical, hands-on projects, you'll build a strong foundation in the technical side of game development, becoming proficient in programming and software design. You'll learn to work with industry-standard coding languages and master game engine mechanics to create innovative and engaging experiences. Areas of study include game architecture, AI programming, and multiplayer functionality, giving you the tools to design systems that are both efficient and exciting to play.

Art direction: Learn how to shape the overall vision of a project and ensure every detail supports its creative impact. In this major, you'll learn advanced techniques in conceptualisation, visual storytelling and art direction principles to guide the look and feel of characters, environments and story-worlds. You'll explore how to develop cohesive styles, create strong visual identities, and communicate artistic intent effectively across animation, games and screen media.

Character animation: Develop advanced skills in rigging, keyframe animation and motion capture integration to create characters that move, emote and interact convincingly. You'll explore the subtle details of timing, weight and expression that make animated performances connect with audiences across games, films and digital media. By blending technical expertise with artistic sensitivity, you'll learn how to craft characters that feel real and relatable, driving storytelling and immersing viewers in dynamic, emotional experiences across a wide range of platforms and genres.

Writing and development: Learn how to write compelling stories, scripts and interactive narratives that capture audience attention and imagination. You'll explore techniques for building authentic characters, dynamic dialogue and engaging worlds, while also understanding how different media and platforms shape storytelling approaches. Alongside creative practice, you'll gain insights into the global screen industry, audience trends and professional pathways.

description:
Start your journey towards becoming an inspiring educator with the Diploma of Education. Designed as a pathway into the Bachelor of Education, this program gives you the strong foundation you need to succeed in your studies and future teaching career. You'll develop essential knowledge and skills in a supportive learning environment while gaining experience in the classroom.

The Diploma of Education introduces you to the theory and practice of teaching, exploring how social, cultural and historical factors shape education. With a focus on digital learning and global perspectives, you'll build an understanding of how beliefs and attitudes influence the way education is delivered and how these impact student learning outcomes.

Highlights of studying the Diploma of Education 
  • Study the same courses as your Bachelor of Education peers.
  • Build your confidence with dedicated support, including a First Year Coordinator and peer-assisted study sessions. 
  • Gain essential skills in curriculum, assessment, teaching methods and educational technologies. 
  • Learn from academics who are recognised for teaching excellence.
A pathway with purpose 

Once you have successfully completed the Diploma of Education, you will be offered guaranteed entry into one of the Bachelor of Education programs (1722, 1723 or 1724) and awarded 80 credit points of credit for the courses completed. You'll graduate with the confidence, knowledge and skills to take on your degree and ultimately make a difference in the lives of future learners.

description:
Turn your passion for learning into a meaningful career with the Master of Primary Teaching. Delivered online and on demand, this degree gives you the flexibility to study at your own pace.

The Master of Primary Teaching offers a direct, flexible pathway into a rewarding career as a qualified primary school teacher. Designed for those with a bachelor degree in another discipline, this degree equips you with the professional knowledge, practical experience and confidence to teach children from Prep to Year 6.

Highlights of studying the Master of Primary Teaching
  • Study online, on demand. Start as soon as you have your offer with no on-campus commitments. Flexible, self-paced online study that fits around your lifestyle.
  • Learn from experienced educators through interactive online modules and personalised academic support.
  • Gain practical experience through 60 days of supervised school placements, building your confidence in real classrooms.
  • Develop the skills and knowledge to teach the Australian Primary Curriculum, including literacy, numeracy and student wellbeing. Explore core topics including child development, curriculum and pedagogy, educational psychology and inclusive teaching practices.
  • Build strong knowledge of the Australian education system and policies, teaching ethics and culturally responsive practice.
Real experience, real classrooms

Throughout your degree, you'll connect theory to practice, studying key concepts in the learning blocks before putting this into practice in the field.

You'll complete 60 days of professional experience in schools. This prac component is scheduled at specific points throughout your degree and aligned with school terms.

Your first placement is 3 weeks full-time (15 days), followed by 4 weeks (20 days) and then 5 weeks (25 days).

Placements will be allocated as close to your residential address as possible subject to availability.

Under the guidance of experienced mentors, you'll learn how to plan lessons, engage young learners and reflect on your teaching practice. Gain the skills to thrive from day one as a graduate teacher.

Teaching for tomorrow's world

Develop the tools to manage diverse classrooms, use technology effectively and differentiate learning for individual student needs. You'll be supported by passionate academic staff and have access to a strong professional network of educators. You'll graduate equipped to teach in public, independent or private primary schools, with skills that reflect the latest educational approaches.

This degree is part of Griffith GO, our 100% online, on-demand degrees that let you start when you're ready, study at your own pace and learn from anywhere.

description:
Make a real impact by tackling today's most pressing health challenges and improving the wellbeing of communities. The Bachelor of Public Health provides the knowledge and skills to promote health, prevent disease and create healthier environments for people everywhere. You'll learn how social, environmental and economic factors influence health and how to design programs and policies that make a lasting difference.

Griffith is ranked #1 in Australia and #2 globally in the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)*, a universal framework for providing health and education for all. This reflects our commitment to creating healthier, fairer and more sustainable societies. As a Griffith public health graduate, you'll be ready to contribute to meaningful change across Australia and internationally.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Public Health
  • Build your understanding of major health issues including chronic disease, sexual health, nutrition, HIV/AIDS, physical inactivity and drug and alcohol abuse, in settings such as workplaces, hospitals and schools.
  • Learn in cutting-edge simulation labs and virtual environments alongside students from other health degrees for authentic team-based learning.
  • Be taught by experts leading research in areas like health promotion, epidemiology, climate change and disease prevention.
  • Explore the world with international study tours and exchanges. 
Step into your career ready to drive change 

Start building your career from day one with mentoring, networking and practical skills that employers look for. This degree integrates employability at every stage to ensure you're career ready. Work with a close-knit cohort with access to dedicated academic advisers, mid-trimester information sessions and regular drop-in sessions with the Program Director.

You'll have assistance with building your CV in your first year, engage with industry experts in the second year, and, in your final year, you'll put your studies into practice through 200 hours of professional placements in public health organisations like Gold Coast University Hospital Public Health Unit or NGOs such as Multicultural Australia.

*Times Higher Education (THE) Impact Rankings 2026

Honours

The Bachelor of Health (Honours) in Public Health (2121) is available through an additional year of study.

description:
Turn your passion for sport into a career that makes an impact on and off the field. This double degree gives you the skills to excel in sport management, community development, and business leadership, preparing you for roles in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

You'll gain expertise in sport development, physiology, biomechanics, psychology and health promotion, while building strong foundations in business strategy, marketing, events, entrepreneurship and management.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Sport Development/Bachelor of Business 
  • Graduate with two degrees in sport development and business, giving you the skills to work across sport, health, and management.
  • Learn how to design and deliver development pathways for elite athletes, or sport and recreation programs that engage communities, nurture talent and promote participation.
  • Study on the Gold Coast with access to world-class facilities, including Olympic-level training venues and high-performance labs.
  • At Australia's #1 university for elite athletes*, you'll join a vibrant sporting community and be well-positioned to play a role in the lead-up to the Brisbane 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
Gain experience and build leadership skills

Develop leadership and teamwork skills through practical projects and collaborative learning experiences. Get industry experience through an 80-hour internship, working with professional organisations and applying your learning to real challenges.

Lead the future of sport 

Whether you dream of developing community programs, managing elite athletes, or leading sport organisations, this degree will set you apart with a powerful combination of industry knowledge and business skill.

*Griffith had more athletes at the 2024 Paris Olympics and Paralympics than any other Australian university.

description:
Offered by Griffith's Autism Centre of Excellence (ACE), the Graduate Certificate in Autism Studies applies a multidisciplinary, whole-of-life focus to autism. Our approach aligns with the latest in neurodiversity research and incorporates authentic insights and voices from the community.

Gain a solid foundational overview of autism and the autistic experience, including:

  • changes that have occurred in understanding of autism over time
  • evidence for interventions
  • creating positive work and learning environments
  • understanding and supporting autistic people.
Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Autism Studies
  • Understand the importance of each person's profile of autism characteristics and assess how this interacts with learning or behaviour.
  • Explore relationships between family and cultural experiences and learn how to effectively critique current models of disability.
  • Critically evaluate research on support strategies that address the strengths and needs of autistic people and learn how to apply them while collaborating with them and their support networks.
  • Collaborative online learning includes lecture videos, live tutorials, video resources, discussion forums and group work, offering opportunities to connect directly with peers.
  • Study anytime, anywhere. This degree is available online, giving you the flexibility to fit university in with your work and life commitments.
Bring research and lived experience together 

Learn from some of Australia's leading autism scholars and explore the perspectives of those with lived personal and professional experience of autism.

Autism Centre of Excellence (ACE)

ACE is a highly respected leader within the global autism and research communities. The Centre seeks to improve the quality of life for autistic children and adults by supporting them from early childhood through to education and employment. ACE also works collaboratively with the state and federal government Education, Health and Communities portfolios to advance understanding of how the wellbeing of autistic people can be supported at a systemic level.

The Graduate Certificate in Autism Studies is a prerequisite for the Master of Autism Studies (5595).

Pursue further study

The courses in this graduate certificate may be credited towards a related graduate diploma or masters degree. Griffith's innovative Credit Precedent Database allows you to find out what credit decisions have been made in the past, which will give you an idea of what you can expect.

description:
Take your place among the next generation of communication professionals. Develop advanced skills in digital media production, content creation, advanced writing and digital communication, tailored for various platforms including emerging technologies.

Ethics and social responsibility are at the core of this degree. This is vital in shaping responsible media professionals who understand the impact of their work. With an emphasis on critical thinking and creativity, you'll develop innovative problem-solving skills, which is why communication at Griffith has a five-star rating for learner engagement*.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Communication
  • Tailor your degree by selecting majors and electives to build a unique skill set, preparing you to work across a range of professions and disciplines.
  • Prepare to launch your career with strong industry networks and a professional portfolio, ready to drive innovation and lead change in the communication and media industries.
  • Be guided and mentored by staff who are recognised as leaders in their fields, including winners of national research and teaching awards.
  • Access industry-level studio facilities including digital TV and radio studios, editing suites, writing and media studios and journalism studios.
  • Embark on study tours to immerse yourself in cultural and language studies.
Gain practical experience while you study

Engage with your community, build professional and social networks and enhance your skills through student news broadcasts, the Griffith Press Club, Journalism Media Centre, The Source News (student-run news channel), community projects, Smallroom Writers Collective and access to The Junction Journalism (a collaborative student journalism project from Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific).

Explore industry opportunities through our partners

Benefit from internships, placements and collaborations with industry leaders including Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC), Channel 9, Channel 7, Swimming Australia, Superdream Marketing Agency, Queensland Ballet, Gold Coast Titans (NRL), Gold Coast Suns (AFL), Brisbane Roar (A-League), Radio Metro and the International Association of Business Communications.

*Good Universities Guide 2026

Majors

Journalism: Build core reporting and writing skills across print, digital and broadcast platforms, from hard news to long-form features. You'll explore investigative techniques, global reporting and human rights journalism, gaining experience with tools like data visualisation, Freedom of Information processes and multimedia storytelling. With a focus on ethical, solutions-driven reporting, this major prepares you for a dynamic media landscape, whether in traditional newsrooms, digital media or independent journalism.

Strategic communication: Learn how to shape messages that influence, engage and inspire. This major prepares you to craft persuasive, ethical communication across industries, from media relations and public campaigns to health, crisis and entertainment communication. You'll gain practical experience developing strategy, managing media and responding to real scenarios including political campaigns and emergency events. Whether you're promoting a brand, managing reputation or navigating public discourse, you'll be equipped with the skills to lead communication in an evolving media landscape.

You can also elect to study a second major, or a minor.

Second majors:

  • Creative writing
  • Events
  • Indigenous studies
  • Innovation and entrepreneurship
  • International relations
  • Journalism
  • Marketing
  • Political science and public policy
  • Screen studies
  • Sport management
  • Strategic communication
  • Tourism and travel.

Minor: 

  • Environmental and climate change communication.

description:
Open the door to global opportunities and take your English teaching expertise to the next level with the Graduate Certificate in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL). Whether you're an experienced teacher or looking to transition into the field, this program will equip you with the skills, confidence and practical strategies to deliver impactful, evidence-based lessons to English language learners in Australia and around the world. 

Explore the structure of the English language in depth, learning analytical tools to examine both written and spoken communication. Through interactive classes, you'll develop a deep understanding of the linguistic, cognitive and pedagogical principles of learning a second language, while also identifying common challenges your students may face and how to help overcome them. 

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in TESOL 

  • Gain advanced knowledge of contemporary issues in second language curriculum design. 
  • Combine theory and practice through lectures, workshops and second language classroom observations at a recognised English language school. 
  • Complete an internship where you'll design, deliver and evaluate your own unit of work for a specific group of language learners. 
  • Learn from industry-active experts in TESOL and applied linguistics. 
  • Enjoy the flexibility of fully online study, making it easier to balance your professional and personal commitments. 

Study TESOL and applied linguistics 

This program is grounded in the latest research and taught by educators with international experience to ensure your learning is relevant, practical and future-focused. You'll benefit from our interactive, problem-based approach to teaching, applying concepts to real-world contexts through case studies, lesson design tasks and classroom observation. 

Please note that this program does not lead to teacher registration with the Queensland College of Teachers. 

Flexibility

Study anytime, anywhere - This degree is available online through our Digital campus, giving you more room to fit university with your work and social life.

Pursue further study

The courses in this graduate certificate may be credited towards a related graduate diploma or masters degree. Griffith's innovative Credit Precedent Database allows you to find out what credit decisions have been made in the past, which will give you an idea of what you can expect.

description:
With a strong focus on evidence-based mental health practice, recovery-oriented care and collaboration with consumers and carers, this degree equips you to work effectively with people living with mental illness, their families and support networks.

The Master of Mental Health Practice is designed for professionals ready to deepen their expertise in mental health, strengthen their clinical capability and progress their careers through specialised postgraduate study.

Highlights of studying the Master of Mental Health Practice
  • Build expertise in suicide prevention, co-occurring conditions and applied counselling for complex presentations.
  • Advance your ethical decision-making through professional ethics and professional practice studies.
  • Learn alongside experienced practitioners from nursing, psychology, social work, occupational therapy and community services, gaining valuable interdisciplinary insight.
  • Undertake a 200-hour placement in a mental health service to consolidate your learning in real settings.
  • Complete an independent practice project or explore First Peoples health and practice to broaden your professional capability.
  • Eligible students may receive credit for approved recognised prior study and/or relevant professional experience, so you could gain a masters in as little as 1 year of full-time study. 
Advanced clinical knowledge for contemporary mental health care

Develop practical skills to respond confidently to complex mental health needs across diverse populations. Studies in research foundations will enable you to critically evaluate evidence, apply best practice and contribute to quality improvement within your workplace. This strong academic foundation supports career progression and may contribute towards mental health worker accreditation, subject to your professional registration body.

Flexible postgraduate study designed for working professionals

Delivered fully online, you'll have the flexibility to balance study with professional and personal commitments. Whether you're a community support worker, rehabilitation practitioner, disability worker, police liaison officer or allied health professional, this qualification will expand your scope of practice and position you for leadership in mental health services.

description:
The Master of Science is a two-year full-time program providing graduates with the opportunity to undertake advanced study and research. This program is designed to provide you with a thorough training in applied scientific research and methodology and will also prepare you for higher degree studies and professional employment. The program consists of both theoretical and practical coursework, as well as a research dissertation. You will complete advanced coursework prior to completing the research component.

The coursework will provide a critical evaluation of research and presentation, develop your knowledge and understanding of statistical analyses techniques as applied to scientific research, and develop an awareness of research proposal design and background. You will have the opportunity to develop a research proposal including aims, methodology and a literature review.

You will undertake a major research project under the supervision of one of our leading researchers. The program has ten different majors aligned to the discipline strengths of the School, including Applied Mathematics, Archaeological Science, Biomedical Science, Bioscience, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Food Security, Forensic Science, Marine Science and Physics.

The degree will be assessed through coursework, research project performance, thesis and seminar.

Industry and expert connections

Griffith has a proud history of leading the way across scientific research. As a student of the Master of Science, you'll have access to leading experts from a range of respected Griffith research centres, including the Australian Research Centre for Human Evolution, Australian Rivers Institute, Institute for Biomedicine and Glycomics and the Quantum and Advanced Technologies Research Centre.

description:
Create a positive impact and deliver life-changing outcomes to people of all ages. Develop the expertise to help individuals, groups and communities participate in the everyday activities that matter most, whether recovering from illness or injury, adapting to disability, or overcoming barriers of marginalisation and exclusion.

You'll gain a deep understanding of the science of health, behaviour and environments, learning how these combine to support participation and wellbeing. Through a mix of theory, practical training and diverse placements, you'll develop the skills to enable people to live meaningful and fulfilling lives.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours)
  • Study human anatomy, psychology and sociology to understand how health impacts daily life.
  • Learn practical therapy skills, exploring rehabilitation, assistive technology and environmental modifications that support people at home, school, work and in the community.
  • Gain practical experience through placements in hospitals, community, disability and mental health settings.
Collaborate and connect

Learn alongside students and staff across health disciplines, preparing you to work as part of a multidisciplinary team. This collaborative approach mirrors real-world practice and ensures you'll graduate ready to make a difference in complex and dynamic healthcare environments.

State-of-the-art facilities

Study in learning spaces designed for practical training and immersive experiences. Our $150 million Griffith Health Centre, on-site clinics, occupational and physical therapy labs and virtual learning environments give you the tools and confidence to apply your skills in practice from day one.

description:
Be part of the next big leap in science and innovation. Shape the future of technology with Queensland's first undergraduate quantum electronic engineering degree. If you're a high-achieving, curious mind excited by cutting-edge technology, this degree offers an opportunity to turn your passion into a future-focused career.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Quantum Electronic Engineering at Griffith
  • This is the only undergraduate degree of its kind in Queensland, designed for the fast-growing quantum technology industry.
  • Gain skills to help solve the complex problems facing science, technology and society, including how to use quantum computing to reduce our energy needs.
  • Blend electrical engineering fundamentals with advanced quantum physics, giving you a unique edge in the tech sector.
  • Enrich your understanding with close industry collaborations, including Griffith's partnership with PsiQuantum, a global leader in quantum computing.
  • Get hands-on experience and exposure to industry trends through guest lectures, research projects, and placement opportunities.
Leverage world-leading research

Your degree is underpinned by the exciting research and facilities from Griffith's Queensland Quantum and Advanced Technologies Research Institute (QUATRI). This research hub has been a leader in quantum technologies for over two decades. You'll learn from experts and researchers who are leading projects in quantum engineering, quantum communications, and sensing-pillars of Australia's National Quantum Strategy.

One-of-a-kind facilities and labs

Work in world-class facilities like Australia's only silicon carbide-on-silicon microfabrication centre and the country's premier attosecond laser lab. You'll get to work on real problems using advanced tools, simulations and labs, preparing you to work with emerging technologies that could transform industries.

description:
The Graduate Diploma of Australian Migration Law and Practice is designed to prepare you to meet the Occupational Competency Standards for Registered Migration Agents. 

Griffith University is recognised and accredited by the Office of the Migration Agents Registration Authority (OMARA) as an approved education provider for this program. 

Upon successful completion of this program, you may apply for registration as an Australian Migration Agent via the OMARA website. Please note that registration with OMARA is only available to Australian citizens or permanent residents, and applicants should ensure they meet all additional OMARA registration requirements, including the additional English language requirements. 

Highlights of studying the Graduate Diploma of Australian Migration Law and Practice 
  • Build a solid foundation in Australian migration law, combining theory and practice to develop the skills and knowledge needed for success. 
  • Designed for lawyers and non-lawyers seeking a career as a registered Migration Agent, as well as professionals in fields like accounting, engineering, ICT, and legal support where migration knowledge can be an asset. 
Your path to success 

A dedicated online capstone preparation module assists you to prepare independently for the mandatory capstone exam required for registration (refer to the OMARA website for full details).

The Bachelor of Advanced Business (Honours) prepares you to tackle complex organisational challenges while giving you the flexibility to specialise in your chosen business discipline. Start with a foundation year, then customise your degree to suit your career goals, whether in marketing, human resources, management, international business or entrepreneurship. In your final years, complete a thesis to showcase your expertise and develop advanced skills that give you a competitive edge in leadership roles across public and private sectors.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Advanced Business (Honours)
  • Start with a foundation year covering marketing, international business, management and organisational psychology.
  • Explore business applications in six discovery courses that help you identify your strengths and passions while preparing for real business challenges.
  • Option to choose a major after your first year to tailor your degree to your career goals, including a language major to enhance global opportunities.
  • Learn through a mix of coursework and practical experiences, including organisational simulations and hands-on business environments.
  • Access personalised mentoring, strong industry connections and pathways to higher research degrees such as a PhD, all in a supportive environment that fosters innovation and leadership.
Study abroad

Engage in internships or study overseas as part of your thesis project in your third and fourth years. This hands-on learning will prepare you with advanced skills that will make you stand out in the competitive job market.

Build your skills and network

Take advantage of transformational international opportunities including competitions and internships. Gain global perspectives and broaden your professional network while earning academic credit for these experiences.

description:
Study a double degree combining advanced laboratory expertise with patient care. Gain the skills to design, create and fit high-quality dentures, crowns and bridges. You'll also develop clinical skills to diagnose and treat patients needing removable dental prostheses. Broaden your career options and graduate with two in-demand qualifications.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Dental Technology/Bachelor of Dental Prosthetics
  • Dual qualifications to work as both a dental technologist and a dental prosthetist.
  • Learn highly specialised skills constructing custom dental devices with traditional and digital techniques including computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/CAM).
  • Train in modern dental laboratories and clinical environments using advanced materials and technologies.
  • Study with dentistry students on real patient cases, through team-based treatment planning that's guided by experienced clinicians and specialists in oral pathology, pharmacology, radiology and prosthodontics.
  • Build strong diagnostic, technical and communication skills for both laboratory and clinical practice. 
Hands-on dental training from day one

In your first three years, you'll develop precision hand skills and technical expertise in dental laboratory. You'll design and fabricate dentures, crowns, bridges and orthodontic appliances and master using materials such as gold, porcelain and advanced polymers.

The professional practice course brings your learning to life as you collaborate on patient cases and refine your problem-solving skills.

In your fourth year, you'll move into clinical dental prosthetics. You'll gain knowledge and the confidence to diagnose, design, fabricate and fit removable, partial and full dentures, to patients. Working in supervised clinics, you'll manage referrals, communicate treatment plans and deliver patient-centered care. 

Double your opportunities 

As a dental technologist, you may work in dental laboratories constructing custom oral devices to international standards to support dentists, prosthodontists, orthodontists and oral surgeons.  

As a dental prosthetist, you could work independently in clinical practice, offering denture services to patients.

Combine legal expertise and business strategy in this double degree, which gives you the tools to understand how laws influence business decisions and how smart business thinking drives innovation and success. You'll graduate ready to lead, advise and make confident decisions in an evolving global marketplace. 

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Laws (Honours)/Bachelor of Business 
  • Study essential business areas like management, marketing and finance, and gain contemporary legal knowledge in core areas of practice including crime, contracts, property and corporate law, torts and theories of law. 
  • Learn from academics and industry experts with strong connections to the business and legal communities. 
  • Put your skills into action and build hands-on experience through internships, legal clinics and work-integrated learning. 
  • Choose from a wide range of business majors to match your interests and goals. 
  • Learn to think critically, negotiate effectively and solve complex problems with confidence. 
Double your opportunities 

The powerful combination of business and law opens doors across industries. You'll be prepared to work in corporate law, business consultancy, governance, or leadership roles where both strategic and legal thinking matter. Whether you're advising companies on compliance, managing teams, or shaping policy, you'll have the insight and adaptability employers value.

description:
The Master of Design (MDes) is an exploration of 21st century creative practices suited to current or emerging designers who wish to become design leaders with social design skills. It provides a suite of courses to equip emerging designers with the necessary skills and existing designers with concepts, strategies, and technologies to solve real-life, complex problems while prioritising ethical and sustainable practices. This includes respecting First Nations cultures and perspectives, and embracing principles of environmental stewardship.

The program offers students the opportunity to advance their skills and knowledge in multiple areas including strategic visual communication, experience and interaction design as well as leadership and social design. These courses are complimented by a range of practical/making courses and exposure to industry leaders through a lecture series. Furthermore, the program offers practical experience and industry exposure via a placement course while also providing access to executive business courses and a PhD pathway.

Students will utilise both collaborative and individual working contexts to expand their knowledge of contemporary design processes at professional industry level. They will gain practical, strategic and critical thinking skills in tune with current and future industry needs. Via courses incorporating briefs, interaction with industry partners, practice-led work and design strategy components, graduates will be prepared for various levels of design.

description:
Take your engineering career to the next level by combining technical expertise with advanced project management skills. This degree equips professional engineers with the knowledge to plan, manage and deliver complex projects across a range of industries, including civil infrastructure, energy, mining, built environment and facility management. 

Highlights of studying the Master of Engineering Project Management
  • Gain advanced skills in project planning, evaluation, control and risk management.
  • Develop the leadership and high-level communication skills essential for engineering management.
  • Learn to integrate quality, safety and environmental management systems into projects.
  • Apply research methods to solve practical engineering challenges and support evidence-based decision-making.
  • Work through project simulations and industry case studies to build practical expertise.
  • Optional advanced study prepares you for higher degree research (PhD) or specialised consultancy. 
Hands-on experience and industry relevance

Guided by expert supervisors, you'll complete major projects that mirror contemporary engineering challenges. Through workshops, case studies and industry-focused assessments, you'll learn to apply advanced project management tools, evaluate project performance and implement solutions that meet regulatory, budgetary and sustainability requirements.

description:
Gain the expertise to lead in today's complex healthcare environment with a Master of Health Services Management. Designed for health professionals, clinicians and managers across health, aged and community care, this degree builds advanced capability in healthcare management, health policy, governance and value-based care.

Highlights of studying the Master of Health Services Management
  • Explore contemporary issues in health services management while strengthening your leadership, strategic and analytical skills for health, aged and social care sectors.
  • Gain expertise in health workforce planning and human resource management.
  • Strengthen your knowledge of healthcare finance, budgeting and resource allocation.
  • Explore digital health technologies, informatics and government policy frameworks.
  • Apply health economics to promote effectiveness, efficiency and equity in care delivery.
  • Develop research capability to support evidence-based management.
  • Eligible students may receive credit for approved recognised prior study and/or relevant professional experience, so you may gain a masters qualification in as little as 1 year of full-time study.
Lead with confidence in complex healthcare systems

Through advanced study in leadership, change management and strategic decision making, you'll develop the capability to lead teams, influence stakeholders and guide organisations through reform and system-wide transformation. You'll gain practical skills in planning, evaluation, negotiation and implementation, enabling you to respond effectively to technological advancement, workforce complexity and increasing service demand across health and aged care settings.

Future-focused health management expertise

Digital transformation is redefining healthcare delivery. Build your expertise in digital health, informatics and technology-enabled care. By integrating healthcare finance, health economics and real industry scenarios, you'll learn to allocate resources responsibly, confidently manage budgets and support value-based models that prioritise quality and sustainability.

description:
The ability to communicate in other languages will help you in almost any career. You can study the Diploma of Languages along with your Bachelor degree. With this option, you will be able to continue learning a language taken at school or start a new language as a beginner while also gaining a separate second degree in another area. Alternatively, you can study only the Diploma of Languages if you are not enrolled in any degree at Griffith University.

Languages

You can specialise in one of the following languages at either the Gold Coast or Nathan campus:

  • Chinese
  • Italian
  • Japanese
  • Spanish.

Note: Applicants seeking admission into the Diploma of Languages for Trimester 2 must be able to provide evidence that they have sufficient proficiency in their chosen language to commence mid-year. Applications for Trimester 2 entry require approval from the Program Director who will assess that a student's proficiency is suitable for mid-year admission to this program.

Applicants seeking admission in Trimester 3 are only able to undertake Japanese or Italian.

description:
Are you looking to build a rewarding career teaching English to non-native speakers? With a mix of academic knowledge and practical teaching skills, this degree prepares you to make a real impact in the world of language education.

Highlights of studying the Master of Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages
  • Prepare to teach English as a second language in diverse settings and contexts, with a strong focus on the Asia-Pacific region.
  • Build an intercultural and global perspective that enhances your teaching approach.
  • Develop the skills to analyse how second and foreign languages are learned, giving you deeper insights into your students' needs.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of online courses, making it easier to balance your studies with your personal and professional life.

You'll further your skills in programming, system design, and application development, then specialise in your choice of major. Whether you're safeguarding digital infrastructure, analysing big data, or building intelligent systems, this degree gives you the tools to lead in fast-evolving ICT sectors.

Highlights of studying the Master of Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence
  • Study online at your own pace with a flexible course structure designed for working professionals. 
  • Major in in Data Analytics or Networking and Cyber Security to align your study with career goals. 
  • Build expertise in foundational areas like programming, databases, and application development before exploring machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and digital ethics.

Prepare for in-demand careers in ICT, cyber security and AI

Consolidate your learning by tackling real IT and AI challenges

The capstone course offers a unique opportunity to consolidate your learning by tackling real challenges in complex and evolving ICT environments. You'll apply advanced technical and analytical skills to projects involving emerging technologies, mirroring the kind of problem-solving demanded in industry. This experience not only strengthens your portfolio and professional confidence, but also demonstrates your ability to lead and deliver practical solutions in dynamic, tech-driven workplaces.

You'll learn to manage and analyse complex datasets using advanced tools and frameworks, including data wrangling, visualisation, and social analytics. Networking and Cyber Security: Gain the skills to build, secure and manage digital infrastructure in a hyperconnected world. description:
The Brisbane South (Nathan) offering of this program is scheduled to be delivered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations.

Build the future of technology with a Bachelor of Software Engineering  

If you want a hand in designing and implementing the software systems our society depends on, our Bachelor of Software Engineering is the ideal degree for you. You'll begin by building a solid foundation in computer systems, engineering principles, mathematics and information systems, laying the groundwork for your future career in software engineering. 

As one of the first universities in Australia to offer a Software Engineering degree, we continue to lead in innovation nearly 30 years on, so you can be confident you'll develop industry-relevant practical skills. This includes the chance to develop software for real clients. In your final year, you will spend over half of your time on work-integrated learning through industry projects, preparing you for a successful career. 

Highlights of studying Software Engineering 
  • A focus on industry engagement in everything we teach ensures the knowledge and skills you gain are directly relevant to your future career in the tech industry, helping you bridge the gap between theory and practice. 
  • You'll develop essential skills in teamwork, project management and quality control by working on real-world projects. These experiences will help you build practical expertise and prepare you for the challenges you'll face in your professional career. 
  • Gain valuable insights firsthand into industry practices including how leaders tackle problems, through a variety of field trips. 
  • You'll learn from practicing engineers directly through laboratory, tutorial sessions, and guest lectures. 
  • Be mentored by an industry partner in your final year, through a significant software engineering research project. You'll collaborate with and be supervised by your industry partner, applying the skills and knowledge you've developed throughout your degree to a real workplace, getting the skills and experience employers want before you graduate. 
Global Mobility

Students may be eligible to do an international field trip, organised by the academic staff. This may count towards a component of the degree, depending on the structure.

The Master of Cyber Security and Artificial Intelligence (AI) equips you with the advanced technical expertise and strategic insight needed to protect critical systems and combat emerging cyber threats in an evolving digital landscape. 

Through a unique blend of cyber security fundamentals and applied artificial intelligence, this postgraduate degree prepares you to assess vulnerabilities, respond to attacks, and implement innovative solutions to protect business, government, and infrastructure sectors. 

You'll explore cyber security and AI challenges and develop skills in ethical hacking, AI-driven threat detection, blockchain security, and cyber governance, making you a powerful force in the future of digital defence. 

Highlights of studying the Master of Cyber Security and Artificial Intelligence 
  • 100% online and on demand. Start when you're ready, set your own pace and pause if you need to. Ideal if you're a professional looking to upskill without compromising your schedule. 
  • Gain two in-demand skill sets in one degree. Master cyber security principles while harnessing the power of artificial intelligence. 
  • Develop expertise through hands-on, project-based learning in ethical hacking, security operations, AI-assisted governance, and distributed system security. 
  • Access immersive simulations and industry-relevant tools, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems and AI-powered analytics. 
  •  Graduate with a professional portfolio that showcases your ability to lead complex cyber security projects supported by AI solutions. 
Be ready for what's next 

This degree prepares you for high-demand roles in a post-quantum world where technology, automation, and cyber threats are evolving at speed. You'll graduate ready to protect critical infrastructure, lead security teams, and design ethical AI-enhanced defence strategies. 

Apply your knowledge in real scenarios 

From simulated cyberattacks to a capstone work project, you'll gain practical experience across the full security lifecycle, including building, managing, and reviewing secure systems.

This degree is part of Griffith GO , our 100% online, on-demand degrees that let you start when you're ready, study at your own pace and learn from anywhere.

In an era where change is the only constant, the Master of Global Development will give you a deep understanding of policy, politics, people and power in a range of development contexts.   • Global Health
  • Human Rights

You will receive the training needed to pursue a specialist career in clinical research settings, including in universities, hospitals, specialist research foundations and government bodies.

The program has been designed to meet the requirements for eligibility for full registration with the Psychology Board of Australia and entry to the Registrar program for the area of practice endorsement in clinical psychology. Understand the forces that shape politics, global affairs and the law. This double degree gives you a powerful combination of legal expertise and political insight, preparing you to navigate the systems and institutions that drive real change.

You'll learn how legal frameworks guide political decisions, how global institutions operate, and how governments respond to pressing challenges such as human rights, conflict, security and social inequality.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Laws (Honours)/Bachelor of Political Science and International Relations
  • Build advanced legal knowledge across crime, contracts, property, corporate law, torts and theories of law while gaining a strong foundation in global politics and diplomacy.
  • Learn essential skills in advocacy, negotiation, analysis, legal writing and political evaluation from practicing lawyers, judges in residence and globally recognised political experts.
  • Explore how law, ethics and international issues intersect in areas such as human rights, global security, conflict, public policy and international law.
  • Gain practical experience through moots, court visits, legal clinics, political simulations and internships.
  • Contribute to real cases through initiatives like the Griffith Legal Clinics and the award-winning Griffith Innocence Project, where you may help address miscarriages of justice.
  • Build global awareness through study abroad programs and industry connections with organisations across government, diplomacy, NGOs and global institutions. 

With hands-on experience, industry connections and the academic support of one of Australia's top law schools, you'll graduate confident, capable and ready for a career on the national or international stage.

description:
Explore the world of architectural design, where creative vision meets research-driven practice. Our Master of Architecture is accredited by the Board of Architects, and it is your first requirement on your path to registration. It equips you with advanced design skills, critical thinking and industry-ready experience so you can contribute to the future of Australian and global built environments. With a strong focus on design research, sustainable thinking and professional practice, this degree prepares you to succeed in your chosen industry.

Highlights of studying the Master of Architecture
  • Build advanced expertise in sustainable design, urban design, building technologies and architectural theory.
  • Develop a research-driven design practice through intensive studio work and design-led inquiry.
  • Learn to investigate and analyse complex design challenges using evidence-informed, creative and culturally responsive approaches.
  • Strengthen your technical capabilities in documentation, construction systems and environmental technologies.
  • Gain professional skills through dedicated practice courses exploring ethics, regulatory frameworks and the realities of architectural work.
  • Complete work-integrated learning placements in leading design practices, gaining practical experience in project delivery, client engagement and studio operations.
Hands-on experience in architectural design and research

Across workshops, studios and professional practice courses, you'll engage with complex design problems and develop creative solutions grounded in research. You'll explore advanced construction systems, adaptive design strategies and environmentally conscious technologies while refining your ability to communicate ideas through drawings, models and digital tools. Through projects that span medium to large-scale buildings, you'll graduate with the confidence to contribute meaningfully to contemporary architectural practice.

Advance your capability as a professional designer 

Establish a strong professional foundation through courses in architectural practice, ethics, community engagement and business operations. Supported by expert academics and practising architects, you'll deepen your understanding of practice management, regulatory responsibilities and the end-to-end project cycle.

Advance your expertise in global politics with a Master of International Relations and gain the advanced knowledge and analytical skills needed to navigate an increasingly complex world. Learn how to critically assess global events, interpret international policy and contribute to informed decision-making at the highest levels.

Highlights of studying the Master of International Relations
  • Work closely with world-class lecturers and researchers to explore diplomacy and statecraft, international security, human rights, globalisation and international organisations.
  • Develop the capacity to analyse power, justice, peace and order in contemporary world politics through rigorous study of international relations theory, foreign policies and global governance.
  • Examine Australia's foreign policy, defence strategy and engagement with Asia and the United States.
  • Analyse terrorism, nuclear proliferation, environmental security and emerging global threats.
  • Develop research expertise through qualitative and quantitative research design and engage with real case studies across diplomacy, peacebuilding and international development.
  • Eligible students may receive credit for approved recognised prior study and/or relevant professional experience, so you may gain a masters qualification in as little as 1 year of full-time study. See entry requirements below. 
Advanced global expertise

Develop a strong theoretical and practical foundation in world politics. Your ability to design and conduct high-level research will be strengthened, preparing you for policy analysis roles or further PhD study.

Majors

Public Policy: Develop advanced skills in policy design, evaluation and ethical leadership. Learn how to measure policy impact, strengthen integrity and anti-corruption systems and lead effective implementation in complex public sector environments. You'll be prepared for senior roles in government, regulatory agencies and advisory positions.

Security, Development and Human Rights: Gain specialist expertise in global security, governance and development. Explore democracy in Asia, gender and security, international ethics and contemporary development challenges. You'll graduate ready for roles in international organisations, foreign affairs, defence, human rights and global policy.
