#2 in Australia for hospitality and management. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Tourism is a major driver of the economy in Queensland, Australia and across the Asia-Pacific. In the Bachelor of International Tourism and Hotel Management, you'll gain a deep understanding of the tourism industry, with a focus on sustainability and responsible leadership.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of International Tourism and Hotel Management 
  • Develop core business skills in financial management, leadership, marketing, strategic management and more, preparing you for leadership roles in the tourism industry.
  • Learn how to run tourism organisations responsibly using sustainable business practices.
  • Explore how to manage teams in diverse workplaces and develop a deep understanding of the global tourism market.
  • Get hands-on with the tools and systems used in the tourism and hospitality industry so you'll graduate with the skills and knowledge employers are looking for. 
Learn from industry leaders  

Benefit from Griffith's connections with major tourism and hospitality industry leaders, gaining practical insights through guest lectures and practical experiences.

Majors 

You can select from a variety of majors to tailor your education to your career aspirations:

Tourism and Travel: Explore the global tourism industry, learning to manage destinations, transport, marketing and infrastructure. Focus on sustainable practices, destination branding and tourism economics to prepare for leadership in a changing international landscape.

Hotel and Hospitality: Develop practical and strategic skills in hotel operations including food and beverage, room division and guest experience. Learn revenue management, sustainable practices and technology integration to lead high-performing hospitality environments.

Events: Gain expertise in designing, managing and evaluating events from community festivals to international conferences. Build practical skills in planning, marketing, project and venue management and business events to lead impactful strategically managed events. 

You can complement your studies with a second major in:

Behavioural Science: Understand the social, cognitive and emotional behaviours of individuals and institutions to drive ethical behaviour change. Apply insights from economics, psychology and social marketing to improve government and individual decision-making.

Business Analytics: Acquire skills to analyse, visualise and interpret data for strategic business decision-making. Bridge the gap between data specialists and decision-makers using insights to solve problems and forecast trends.

Innovation and Entrepreneurship: Learn to develop, launch and manage innovative products or businesses. Gain the knowledge, skills and confidence to nurture and grow successful start-ups.

Logistics and Supply Chain Management: Develop expertise in sourcing, supplier relations, inventory management and goods movement. Learn to optimise supply chains to meet business and operational goals efficiently.

Management: Build the skills to plan, organise, lead and direct teams effectively. Gain knowledge in communication, strategy, human resources and decision-making to add value across organisations.

Marketing: Understand markets, consumer behaviour and audience engagement strategies. Learn data-driven decision-making, innovative promotions and communications to stay ahead of competitors.

Political Science and International Relations: Prepare for careers in government, global trade and politics with expert-led study. Gain the knowledge and skills to navigate complex political and international landscapes.

Real Estate and Property Development: Develop specialist knowledge in finance, law, project management and negotiation for the property sector. Learn from industry collaborations to succeed in Australia's dynamic property market.

Sport Management: Turn your passion for sport into a career by developing business and management skills for sporting organisations. Gain hands-on experience to lead professional and not-for-profit clubs locally and internationally.

You may also choose to minor in:

Tourism Data Analytics (not offered from 2027): Learn to harness data for smarter decision-making in tourism and hospitality. Gain hands-on experience with analytics tools, e-commerce platforms and business intelligence systems to analyse trends and improve customer experiences.

description:
Queensland's #1 university for law and criminology. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Combine scientific expertise with a deep understanding of criminal behaviour and the justice system. This double degree equips you with the knowledge and practical skills to analyse forensic evidence, understand crime trends and contribute to investigations and legal processes.

When you study Queensland's only forensic science degree at the leading university for criminology in Queensland, you'll learn from dedicated practising academics and industry professionals who bring their expertise, unique experience and cutting-edge research into the classroom. You'll benefit from a science-first curriculum with a focus on core chemistry and biology alongside forensics, giving you insight into both the scientific and social dimensions of crime.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Forensic Science/Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice
  • Study Australian crime trends and take courses that cover policing, courts and criminal law, forensic psychology and homicide.
  • Choose from majors in forensic molecular biology or forensic chemistry to gain crime scene, laboratory and investigative skills trusted by employers, with extensive hands-on lab experience.
  • Build professional identity and networks through the Criminology Student Society, including organised tours with police and corrections.
  • Attend Australian and New Zealand Forensic Science Society events and guest talks that clarify real forensic career pathways.
  • Learn in a supportive student community with strong industry connections.
Industry and expert connections 

Complete a professional placement in your final year to gain in-field experience and expand your career options beyond traditional forensic roles. Eligible students may join the Criminology Undergraduate Research Internship Program, undertaking a research project with one-on-one mentorship from criminology experts. These competitive internships run three times a year and are a unique opportunity available only at Griffith, supported by direct connections with industry experts.

Practical and professional knowledge

You'll learn from experienced staff with long academic and professional careers, giving you direct insight into the standards and expectations of the industry. Your lecturers will have worked in laboratories, conducted forensic analysis and provided expert evidence in court, bringing authentic case knowledge into the classroom.

Majors

Forensic Chemistry: Develop the skills to analyse chemical evidence, understand toxicology and apply modern analytical techniques in real forensic investigations. Gain hands-on experience with laboratory methods and instrumentation to prepare for careers in forensic science, law enforcement and investigative research.

With Royal Australian Chemical Institute (RACI)-accredited forensic chemistry training, you'll graduate with analytical and laboratory skills valued across forensic agencies, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies and private laboratories, broadening your career opportunities well beyond traditional settings.

Forensic Molecular Biology: Explore DNA analysis, protein science, molecular genetics and cell biology, with a focus on forensic applications. You'll gain practical experience in advanced laboratory techniques, including DNA profiling and molecular investigations, preparing you for careers in forensic science, biotechnology and research.

description:
Disrupt, innovate and work with industry as you design your way to success. The Bachelor of Design addresses the global need for designers who can navigate the complexities of contemporary society, creatively, ethically and sustainably.

Our studio-first program, registered by the Design Institute of Australia (DIA), cultivates high levels of design expertise. You'll learn in innovative, creative studio spaces at the Queensland College of Art and Design and leverage unique opportunities in our world-class facilities, including galleries and purpose-built design studios.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Design
  • Work with experts from the design industry to tackle real challenges and create innovative solutions.
  • Advance your critical and strategic thinking and learn to present your ideas clearly and powerfully.
  • Learn from award-winning design professionals and educators, with experience across a wide range of design practices.
  • Learn with purpose in this inclusive degree with a focus on making a difference in the field of design and understanding First Nations culture and perspectives.
  • Take your learning global with overseas study options that could last a few weeks or even a whole year.
Turn your ideas into experience with internships and studio projects 

You'll get the chance to do internships and take part in creative studio projects as part of your degree, helping you build your skills and make professional connections.

Majors
Visual communication design

Explore many different forms of visual and graphic communication and branding and gain a deeper understanding of the social contexts and environmental responsibilities of design. You'll learn to develop design solutions that inform, persuade, provoke and entertain your audience, as well as how to effectively present and communicate your ideas within this evolving industry.

In studio classes, you'll have the creative freedom to explore topics that matter to you and gain industry-informed skills in print media, screen-based interfaces (UI/UX), brand identity, motion, creative entrepreneurship and graphic design solutions.

LiveWorm-our award-winning design studio-provides an opportunity to kick-start your career by working with real clients and building a professional portfolio under the guidance of experienced teaching staff.

This major prioritises intercultural perspectives and inclusive world views while building your understanding of our responsibilities as global design citizens.

Interior design

Prepare to explore diverse spaces and societies, crafting imaginative interiors and public spaces across various scales and domains. With a strong focus on social and environmental justice, sustainability, liveability, diversity and inclusion, this major integrates theory with hands-on practice. Gain a comprehensive toolkit of technical skills, from architectural to digital design programs, while honing your abilities in analysis and critical thinking.

An emphasis on creativity ensures you're equipped to tackle complex challenges with innovative and creative solutions, fostering meaningful contributions to the built environment and society at large.

Product and user experience design

Passionate about using cutting-edge digital technology to design unique products and experiences? This major equips you with hands-on skills in additive manufacturing (3D printing), virtual modelling, simulation, laser cutting and CNC fabrication.

You'll learn future-ready skills that combine both the physical and digital worlds, while also evaluating the impact your designs have on people and the environment. You'll use user-focused design methods and hands-on digital tools to create new products, systems and services that change the way people live in and interact with the world.

You'll also explore the foundational concepts that underpin modern AI, such as logic, reasoning and optimisation, enabling you to develop systems that are accurate, explainable and impactful.

description:
Take the next step in your academic and professional journey with Griffith's Master of Education and Professional Studies Research. Designed for educators and professionals who want to deepen their expertise and advance their careers, this degree equips you with the research skills needed to address challenges in education and related fields. You'll build advanced knowledge in research design and methodology while completing a substantial dissertation (approximately 30,000 words) on a topic that matters to you.

Learn to think critically about education and professional practice, master both qualitative and quantitative research methods and design and execute impactful projects. Supported by expert supervisors and researchers, you'll graduate with the ability to influence policy, improve practice and open doors to future doctoral study. It's advisable to meet with the program convenor prior to enrolment.

Highlights of studying the Master of Education and Professional Studies Research 
  • Learn from leading academics with expertise across diverse education and professional practice fields.
  • Build advanced skills in qualitative, quantitative and mixed-methods research.
  • Develop and complete a major research project with the support of experienced supervisors.
  • Join a collaborative research culture with access to seminars, workshops and mentoring.
  • Graduate ready to pursue a doctoral program or research-focused roles in education, government, community or professional sectors.
A degree that shapes your future 

This program is your pathway to doctoral study and a career in research-intensive roles. You'll be prepared to contribute to higher education, research organisations, policy institutes, NGOs and professional bodies, where your expertise can influence the way education and practice evolve. Whether you're aiming to transition into academia or enhance your current role with strong research capability, this degree gives you the skills to lead with insight and impact.

This degree is not an initial teacher education program and will not lead to registration as a teacher in Queensland schools.

description:
Some courses in this program are scheduled to be offered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations.

Prepare for a future where legal expertise meets cutting-edge biomedical discovery. This double degree gives you a powerful combination of skills in legal reasoning, scientific investigation and ethical decision making, opening doors across healthcare, research, policy and emerging biotech industries.

You'll build a strong foundation in both fields, learn in hands-on environments and graduate ready to take on the complex challenges influencing modern health and medical innovation.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Laws (Honours)/Bachelor of Biomedical Science
  • Build a deep understanding of biomedical science including genetics, biochemistry, anatomy, physiology, microbiology, infectious disease and neuroscience.
  • Get hands-on from your first year with real lab and cadaver-based anatomy experiences.
  • Develop in-demand legal skills in negotiation, advocacy, critical analysis and legal writing.
  • Explore how law interacts with healthcare, biotechnology, bioethics, medical research and intellectual property.
  • Learn in cutting-edge labs and simulated environments, supported by placements and links with leading research institutes.
  • Learn from academics, clinicians and legal professionals who bring industry-relevant insights to your study.
Build networks for your future career through practical learning across disciplines

In biomedical science, you'll train in advanced labs using industry-standard technology and explore challenges in disease, diagnostics and emerging medical research. In law, you'll gain practical legal experience from your first year through moots, court visits, industry networking and opportunities with our Griffith Legal Clinics. These experiences help you build a strong professional network while learning to analyse complex issues from both scientific and legal perspectives.

A powerful double degree for an evolving industry

Studying law alongside biomedical science gives you the tools to navigate the growing ethical, regulatory and policy questions in modern healthcare. You'll develop the ability to evaluate legislation, assess risk, advise on research governance and contribute to responsible medical innovation. This skill combination is increasingly sought after across legal, scientific, government and industry settings.

description:
Learn the skills to lead safety initiatives in a way that emphasises practical expertise and results. The Graduate Certificate in Safety Leadership will move you beyond traditional, linear cause-and-effect thinking that has long defined characterised safety work in Australia. You'll be encouraged to challenge the conventional focus on processes and compliance, exploring the principles of resilience, complexity science and holistic approaches to safety.  

This graduate certificate is designed for both those new to the safety field and experienced professionals seeking to advance their expertise. 

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Safety Leadership 
  • Examine key theories of accidents, risk and human reliability to understand why incidents occur and how to prevent them, including Normal Accidents Theory and Human Reliability Theory. 
  • Analyse accident models and critically evaluate safety systems and practices to drive workplace improvements. 
  • Strengthen your own safety practice through critical self-assessment and reflection. 
  • Learn from experienced academics, graduates and industry professionals in interactive lectures, seminars and group work. 
Redefine safety with a people-centred approach 
  • Move beyond traditional, limited views of workplace safety and explore systems and processes that truly drive high safety standards. You'll learn to implement effective safety management strategies while adopting a mindset that sees people as key to solving safety challenges. By placing empathy at the core of your approach, you'll contribute to creating safer, more supportive work environments. 

Flexibility

Study anytime, anywhere - This degree is available online through our Digital campus, giving you more room to fit university with your work and social life.

Pursue further study

The courses in this graduate certificate may be credited towards a related graduate diploma or masters degree. Griffith's innovative Credit Precedent Database allows you to find out what credit decisions have been made in the past, which will give you an idea of what you can expect.

The Brisbane South (Nathan) offering of this program is scheduled to be delivered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations.

Lead across borders with a Master of International Business and build the strategic expertise to succeed in global business. Designed for ambitious graduates and professionals, this degree gives you the advanced international business knowledge, cross-cultural leadership and digital economy insight to thrive in multinational environments.

Highlights of studying the Master of International Business
  • Develop advanced skills in international business strategy and global market analysis.
  • Build intercultural expertise to lead across diverse teams and regions.
  • Analayse and understand how global trade, country risk and investment environments operate.
  • Strengthen your skills in negotiation and ethical decision-making, while deepening your understanding of corporate responsibility.
  • Griffith brings decades of global business expertise and the benefits of an internationally diverse student cohort to enrich your learning and networking.
  • Engage directly with future employers through industry projects, internships and global exchange opportunities.
Develop global business strategy and leadership capability

International business demands strategic thinking and cultural intelligence. Leaders also need to respond to geopolitical disruption, digital transformation and evolving trade environments. You'll examine global business dynamics, multinational enterprise strategy and cross-border decision-making; while analysing how nationalism, protectionism and shifting trade rules influence global operations. Develop practical frameworks to assess risk, competitiveness and opportunity in complex international markets.

Strengthen your capacity to lead across cultures, manage conflict and guide diverse teams through applied negotiation and case-based learning. With a focus on the digital economy and entrepreneurial leadership, you'll explore how emerging technologies drive global value creation. Become an expert in sustainable business models, while building the communication, analytical and interpersonal skills expected in high-level roles.

Industry engagement and global experience

This masters degree focuses on real-world experience and applying your knowledge in practice. You may undertake supervised internships, industry-linked projects with local and international corporations or participate in exchange programs in Asia, North America or Europe through Griffith's worldwide alliances. Develop your teamwork as you analyse real companies, produce strategic reports and deliver professional pitches in interdisciplinary teams.

The Brisbane South (Nathan) offering of this program is scheduled to be delivered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations.

description:
TAKE YOUR ARTS LEARNING TO THE NEXT LEVEL.

Bachelor of Arts graduates can undertake an additional year of study in the Honours program, which gives you the opportunity to build on the skills and knowledge gained in the foundation degree.

The Honours degree allows you to put to practical use the knowledge you've gained in the first three years of your degree, and it prepares you for postgraduate study and professional opportunities.

An Honours qualification may also help to set you apart from your peers, signalling to employers that you possess the abilities and knowledge they value, including critical thinking, time management and interpersonal engagement.

Industry and expert connections

The Bachelor of Arts (Honours) is an excellent entry path towards a PhD, and also signals to employers that you're capable of managing a large independent program under supervision. Internships may be available to students within the Honours program.

Graduate outcomes

In this year-long professional and educational experience, you'll do original research, use analytical skills,and work as part of a team environment to take your learning to the next level. As a graduate, you will be ready for highly skilled professional work or may choose to continue your education with a higher degree by research.


Flexibility

Tailor your timetable - Even if you study full-time on-campus, you may still be able to customise your degree to suit your needs. From a range of tutorial times to online access to lectures and other course material, we're here to help you fit study in with your work and life commitments.

Global mobility

Students in this degree may be able to participate in an overseas program specifically designed to fit the degree's teaching objectives. Learn more about going global at Griffith.

description:
Get hands-on, industry-focused training for technical roles in film, TV and digital media. The Diploma of Technical Screen Production offers a direct, practice-based pathway into film, television and digital media careers.  

Developed in close collaboration with industry, the diploma will equip you with the technical and professional skills required for entry-level crew roles across the screen production industry. 

Highlights of studying the Diploma of Technical Screen Production 

  • Train in purpose-built facilities at Griffith Film School, with access to professional cameras, lighting, sound and production gear. 
  • Gain experience rotating through crew roles such as camera assistant, boom operator, lighting assistant, production runner and art department assistant. 
  • Master essential production skills including set safety, crew protocols, location logistics, and technical operations. 
  • Learn from experienced screen practitioners and industry mentors. 
  • Complete a capstone course that places you in crew rotations on set, simulating the workflow of professional screen productions to build confidence and practical capabilities. 

Industry-focused training that leads to real opportunities 

The Diploma of Technical Screen Production responds directly to industry demand and the national shortage of trained screen crew. You'll gain valuable on-set experience, build your technical toolkit, and develop the teamwork and problem-solving skills needed to thrive in fast-paced production environments. 

This diploma is ideal if you're seeking immediate employment in the screen sector, whether that's freelance, studio-based, or location-based productions across Australia's rapidly expanding screen industry.

description:
Advance your professional skills and make a meaningful impact on students' learning and development with the Graduate Certificate in Special Education.

Although this postgraduate program does not qualify you as a teacher, it is designed for education professionals and support staff who work with, or wish to work with, students with diverse learning needs in primary, secondary and special school settings.

Through evidence-based approaches, you'll gain the specialist knowledge and practical strategies needed to engage effectively with students, school staff and parents to support learning, behaviour and wellbeing.

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Special Education
  • Develop expertise in equitable and inclusive education, exploring historical and contemporary approaches, legislation and societal influences shaping special education.
  • Gain practical skills to implement inclusive philosophies, policies and evidence-based strategies for students with diverse abilities, including gifted and twice-exceptional learners.
  • Learn to adapt curriculum, instruction and assessment using differentiation and Universal Design for Learning (UDL) to ensure meaningful engagement for all students.
  • Deepen your understanding of student behaviour considering context, communication, sensory profiles and environment to design proactive, supportive behaviour plans.
  • Collaborate with industry experts and experienced educators through online learning, seminars and group projects to enhance your professional networks and applied practice.
  • Graduate with a postgraduate qualification in just one year of part-time study.
Study with leading education professionals

Griffith is recognised for excellence in teaching and research in inclusive and special education. You'll learn from experienced academics and practitioners, gaining insights into contemporary strategies and real-world applications that enhance your ability to effectively support learners with diverse needs.

Increase your expertise in workplace relations, people management and employment law to advance your career with a Graduate Certificate in Employment Relations and Human Resource Management.

This program suits graduates and working professionals wanting to build specialist knowledge and skills in human resource management, industrial relations and organisational policy within Australian and global contexts.

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Employment Relations and Human Resource Management
  • Develop expertise in employment relations policy, workplace law and human resource management.
  • Examine Australia's employment regulatory environment, enterprise bargaining and industrial relations frameworks.
  • Build your capacity to manage employee diversity and inclusion across complex organisations.
  • Expand your knowledge of risk management and work health and safety obligations.
  • Deepen your skills in academic writing, critical analysis, research and digital literacy.
  • Graduate in as little as six months of full-time study.
Expand your employment relations and HR capability

Develop a deeper understanding of how employment relationships are structured, regulated and managed across private, public and not-for-profit sectors.

Build your legal research and writing skills to support sound policy development and compliance through analysing legislation and interpreting case law. You'll also evaluate workplace risk and develop strategies to support safe, compliant and high-performing organisations.

Queensland's #1 university for political science. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects, tied position, 2026)

Step into the world of politics, power and justice with this double degree that combines political science and international relations with criminology and criminal justice. You'll be empowered to see the bigger picture, connect global issues, national policy and local justice systems and influence change at every level of society.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Political Science and International Relations/Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice
  • Gain a deep understanding of how societies are governed, why people commit crimes and how evidence-based policy can contribute to safer and fairer communities.
  • Study political systems, diplomacy and global relations to understand the forces shaping both Australian and international policy.
  • Build career-ready skills through internships, field trips and placements in parliamentary, policy and criminal justice fields.
  • Broaden your horizons with overseas study or international experiences that boost your global career potential.
Learn from experts in policy and justice 

Be taught by experts at the forefront of criminology research and practice and gain real insights into how politics and justice work. Our academics and practitioners work closely with government departments, law enforcement agencies and international organisations such as the UN, World Bank and Interpol. Their research and expertise ensure your learning stays relevant.

Double your impact 

By combining political science and criminology, you'll graduate with an advanced understanding of how public policy, law and justice intersect. Whether you're interested in national policy, investigating crime trends or working in international relations, this double degree gives you the analytical, research and communication skills to make an impact.

Political science and international relations majors 

International Relations: Discover how power, conflict and cooperation shape global affairs. Explore key issues like diplomacy, security, migration, and climate change and understand how global forces influence politics and policy.

Political Science and Public Policy: Examine how power works in society and how decisions are made. Study elections, governance, media, and policy development to gain the skills to analyse political behaviour and influence real change.

Security, Conflict and Human Rights: Investigate how global power struggles, political violence and human rights intersect. Study major issues such as terrorism, authoritarianism, and international peacekeeping to understand how nations respond to conflict and crises.

Blend creativity with commercial know-how. This double degree equips you with strong communication skills and a future-focused business foundation, so you can thrive in industries where ideas, strategy and innovation come together.

You'll learn how to craft compelling stories, analyse audiences, manage campaigns and understand what drives organisations, all while building a deep understanding of ethical, sustainable and inclusive business practice.

description:
DEVELOP YOUR SKILLS FOR A LIFE AGAINST CRIME.

The Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice (Honours) is designed for students who want to hone their knowledge and skills through research.

You'll gain research training at a standard that will prepare you for postgraduate studies in justice administration, criminal justice or criminology. You'll also learn about advanced theoretical concepts and policy debates in contemporary criminology - setting you up to access a career at more than an entry-level position in the criminal justice system.

Your research will help to identify the social issues that lead to crime. You'll also learn to understand what makes criminals tick as well as how to minimise the negative impacts of crime on society.

Industry and expert connections

At Griffith, criminology has always had a strong industry connection and a high level of cooperation from police agencies and other crime related bodies. This Honours degree continues the tradition with a multitude of opportunities to meet with and hear from industry experts.

Graduate outcomes

This degree sets you to enter the criminal justice system in a broader and usually higher range of rewarding roles such as an analyst or program design consultant - careers where the ability to do independent research is key. It also offers you a great pathway into a PhD, a Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice (Honours) puts you one step ahead.

Flexibility

Tailor your timetable - Even if you study full-time on-campus, you may still be able to customise your degree to suit your needs. From a range of tutorial times to online access to lectures and other course material, we're here to help you fit study in with your work and life commitments.

Global mobility

This may be possible through a study abroad opportunity or through Criminology Student Society organised experiences with police and corrections.

For more information on projects commencing from 2024 onwards please click on the following link: CCJ Research Project Showcase 2026.pdf

description:
You've done the hard work to complete your degree and are now keen to put it into practice through a research project. The Bachelor of Science (Honours) lets you take that next step. It is only available if you have achieved a GPA of 5 in the second and third years of your Bachelor degree and have organised your project and a supervisor.

You'll undertake a major research project under the supervision of one of our leading researchers. The degree will be assessed through coursework, research project performance, thesis and seminar. This is the opportunity to hone your skills and demonstrate your research ability under the eyes of an experienced science professional.

Industry and expert connections

Griffith has a proud history of leading the way across scientific research. As a student of the Bachelor of Science (Honours), you'll have access to leading experts from a range of respected Griffith research centres, including the Australian Rivers Institute, Institute for Biomedicine and Glycomics, Quantum and Advanced Technologies Research Centre and the Sea Jellies Research Laboratory.

You'll complete your honours project in your chosen specialisation, putting all that you have learnt into a tangible, rewarding project.

Graduate outcomes

The Bachelor of Science (Honours) is your pathway to a PhD and a career in scientific research. You'll also be qualified for higher degree by research studies and scientific research in Australia and overseas. As a graduate, you'll also gain the knowledge required to make successful grant applications in order to further your research.

Flexibility

Fast-track your finish line - With intensive study options (and/or) year-round classes available, this degree can be finished in less time than a standard full-time study load, getting you into the workforce faster.

description:
Get ready for an exciting career blending health, science, and sports with Griffith University's Diploma of Exercise Science. This program lays the groundwork for your journey into the world of exercise science. Through a mix of practical experience and learning the basics, you'll understand how our bodies work during exercise and how it affects our health.

The program offers a variety of courses covering everything from how our muscles move to the science behind staying healthy. You'll dive into topics like how and what makes us move the way we do. Plus, you'll get hands-on experience, learning in modern facilities and working alongside athletes and experts in the field.

Once you've successfully completed this diploma, you'll be offered guaranteed entry into the second year of the Bachelor of Exercise Science (1171).

Industry and expert connections

As a student in the Diploma of Exercise Science, you'll have access to world-class facilities and resources at the Griffith Health Centre, a cutting-edge facility dedicated to advancing health education and research. Here, you'll find state-of-the-art clinics and lab classrooms, providing the perfect environment for immersive learning and skill development. Additionally, you'll have the unique opportunity to work alongside elite athletes and industry professionals, gaining invaluable insights and mentorship as you embark on your academic journey.

description:
Make an impact as a medical scientist 

Play a vital role in improving patient health by conducting diagnostic tests and recommending treatment options. As a medical scientist, you will perform tests on blood, tissues, and other bodily fluids to help doctors diagnose a range of diseases, including glandular fever, diabetes, swine flu, and cancer. You could also contribute to the success of clinical trials, advancing healthcare innovations that will shape the future of medicine. 

Highlights of the Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science: 
  • Work internationally following graduation - Griffith is Australia's only internationally accredited medical science degree, allowing you to work in the UK and other Commonwealth countries. 
  • The only program in Australia to enable you to gain hands-on experience in all 6 disciplines of Medical Laboratory Science. This degree offers practical experience in blood transfusion and immunology, clinical biochemistry, haematology, histopathology, microbiology, and molecular diagnosis. The Medical Sciences job market is booming, with a projected growth of over 6.5% by 2028. 
  • Develop your foundational knowledge in medical science with core subjects including general chemistry, cell biology, anatomy, and physiology which will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of how the body functions in both healthy and diseased states. 
  • From your second year onwards, you will focus on specialist areas of medical laboratory science, learning to diagnose diseases, and delve deeper into blood transfusions, immunology, clinical biochemistry, haematology, histopathology, microbiology, and molecular diagnostics. 
  • Graduate job ready. In your fourth year, you will gain hands-on experience through full-time clinical placements, immersing yourself in various disciplines of laboratory medicine. You will apply your theoretical knowledge to real-world medical challenges. 

Honours are available through an additional year of study for students who want to examine medical laboratory science in finer detail.

description:
Start your journey toward becoming a registered architect with this complete academic pathway designed for ambitious creators, problem-solvers and future design leaders. This degree takes you from foundational design skills through to advanced architectural expertise, giving you the practical experience, technical capability and professional readiness for a career in architecture.

You will need to successfully complete the Bachelor of Architectural Design in order to progress to the Master of Architecture in your fourth year.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Architectural Design/Master of Architecture
  • Build essential design, drawing and digital modelling skills in expert-led studios as you learn to balance creativity with function, user experience and client needs.
  • Focus on sustainable and resilient design, exploring green technologies and industry practices for tropical, sub-tropical and coastal environments.
  • Develop your design approach through immersive field trips, site studies and hands-on studio projects.
  • Examine how creative thinking, sustainable practice and design research connect to create meaningful, future-focused built environments.
  • Grow your capability in urban design, history and theory, construction knowledge and research-led design methods.
  • Complete industry placements and build strong professional connections for your future career.
A direct pathway to becoming an architect

This vertical degree is structured so you can move seamlessly from undergraduate foundations into your professional qualification. In your architectural design studies, you'll strengthen your creative and technical abilities through collaborative studios and real project work, supported by experienced academics and practising architects.

Once you progress into the masters component you'll deepen your expertise with advanced design-research, sustainable futures, urban design and theoretical exploration. You'll refine your design identity, learn to tackle complex architectural challenges and develop the analytical and investigative skills that underpin high-level professional practice.

Develop your professional readiness

Join a strong community of peers, alumni and professionals who support your growth as you develop a compelling portfolio that reflects your skills, interests and career goals. By the time you complete the masters, you'll be equipped to confidently step into practice with a contemporary perspective on architecture.

description:
Advance your expertise in crime, justice and public policy with a Graduate Certificate in Criminology and Criminal Justice. Designed for professionals seeking to deepen their understanding of crime in contemporary society, you'll gain the analytical, research and critical thinking skills needed to progress in justice, policy and community-focused roles.

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Criminology and Criminal Justice
  • Develop advanced knowledge of criminological theories and contemporary crime issues.
  • Examine the structure, effectiveness and fairness of the criminal justice system.
  • Build research skills to create evidence-based policy and practice.
  • Explore how law and human behaviour interact in criminal justice settings.
  • Graduate with a postgraduate qualification in just one year of part-time study.
Deepen your understanding of crime and justice 

Explore theories explaining crime and criminal behaviour from sociological and psychological perspectives and learn how to apply contemporary approaches. You'll critically evaluate current and emerging policies, institutions and reforms within an Australian and international context. Examine debates around fairness, effectiveness and accountability while analysing how justice systems respond to complex social challenges.

You'll investigate how psychological principles interact with legal processes, including eyewitness testimony, jury decision-making and expert evidence. You'll also learn how to collect, analyse and interpret data, evaluate evidence and communicate findings clearly and professionally.

A pathway to further study 

We recommend this graduate certificate if you're returning to university, changing fields, or preparing for postgraduate study. It's an ideal starting point towards further study in the Master of Criminology and Criminal Justice (5761), as you may get credit for completed courses.

description:
Advance your nursing career and make a meaningful difference in the lives of children and their families with the Graduate Certificate in Paediatric Nursing. Designed for registered nurses, this program builds specialist knowledge and skills in paediatric care, equipping you to manage complex health needs in diverse clinical settings. 

This graduate certificate provides a pathway to develop advanced clinical expertise and leadership capability within paediatric nursing. Please note that successful completion of this program does not lead to eligibility to apply for registration as a nurse. Prospective students seeking eligibility to apply for registration should refer to the Bachelor of Nursing (1162). 

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Paediatric Nursing 
  • Build expertise in advanced health assessment to analyse patient data and guide care decisions. 
  • Develop confidence in managing complex client situations with critical thinking and evidence-based practice. 
  • Explore paediatric nursing across acute, chronic, family-centred and culturally diverse care contexts. 
  • Enhance leadership and change management skills to drive innovation and improve healthcare delivery. 
  • Apply learning through real-world scenarios and discussions to sharpen problem-solving, collaboration and professional judgement. 
Advance your skills in patient-centred child and family healthcare 

Through a combination of interactive workshops, case-based learning and evidence-based study, you'll develop advanced assessment, critical thinking and patient-centred care skills. You'll learn to support children and families through acute and chronic health challenges, integrating cultural understanding and family-focused strategies into your practice. 

Study with Australia's leading nursing educators 

Griffith University is ranked No. 1 in Australia for nursing and midwifery and is globally recognised for excellence in nursing and midwifery education, research and clinical practice. You'll learn from experienced paediatric nurses and academic experts, gaining insights into best practice and the latest developments in child healthcare.

Combine your understanding of global markets and international policy expertise to become a strategic leader. Explore and deepen your knowledge of how global markets, international organisations and government policy interact. Develop the analytical, strategic and negotiation skills needed to navigate complex international environments, while gaining highly-regarded masters qualifications in just two years of full-time study.

  • Explore peacebuilding, foreign policy and global security issues and learn how trade, risk and strategy influence business and policy decisions across the Asia-Pacific.

  • Customise your studies with a major that aligns to your career goals.

#2 in Australia for hospitality and management. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Start your journey as a global tourism leader. This degree prepares you to lead and innovate across the tourism, hospitality and event sectors. You'll gain in-depth business and management skills while exploring sustainable, responsible practices that make a real difference in the world of travel and hospitality.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Advanced International Tourism and Hotel Management (Honours)

  • At Australia's #1 university for hospitality and tourism management you'll learn from the best as you develop expertise in sustainable tourism.
  • Learn how to lead responsibly and manage growth with environmental and community impact in mind. 
  • Build strong connections with industry leaders through guest lectures, internships and projects that enhance your employability.
  • Gain advanced business knowledge in financial management, marketing, leadership, strategy and skills that translate across industries.
  • Learn to manage diverse teams and navigate the complexities of global tourism markets using the latest digital tools and systems.

Honours advantage 

Through your honours year, you'll take your expertise even further, specialising in an area of interest, developing your research and analytical skills and setting yourself apart as a future-ready professional in this global industry.

Enrol directly into the honours stream or transition from the Bachelor of International Tourism and Hotel Management if eligible. Your honours year allows you to focus on research and specialised study.

Majors

You can select from a variety of majors to tailor your education to your career aspirations:

Tourism and Travel: Explore the global tourism industry, learning to manage destinations, transport, marketing and infrastructure. Focus on sustainable practices, destination branding and tourism economics to prepare for leadership in a changing international landscape.

Hotel and Hospitality: Develop practical and strategic skills in hotel operations including food and beverage, room division and guest experience. Learn revenue management, sustainable practices and technology integration to lead high-performing hospitality environments.

Events: Gain expertise in designing, managing and evaluating events from community festivals to international conferences. Build practical skills in planning, marketing, project and venue management and business events to lead impactful, strategically managed events.

You can complement your studies with a second major in:

Behavioural Science: Understand the social, cognitive and emotional behaviours of individuals and institutions to drive ethical behaviour change. Apply insights from economics, psychology and social marketing to improve government and individual decision-making.

Business Analytics: Acquire skills to analyse, visualise and interpret data for strategic business decision-making. Bridge the gap between data specialists and decision-makers using insights to solve problems and forecast trends.

Innovation and Entrepreneurship: Learn to develop, launch and manage innovative products or businesses. Gain the knowledge, skills and confidence to nurture and grow successful start-ups.

Logistics and Supply Chain Management: Develop expertise in sourcing, supplier relations, inventory management and goods movement. Learn to optimise supply chains to meet business and operational goals efficiently.

Management: Build the skills to plan, organise, lead and direct teams effectively. Gain knowledge in communication, strategy, human resources and decision-making to add value across organisations.

Marketing: Understand markets, consumer behaviour and audience engagement strategies. Learn data-driven decision-making, innovative promotions and communications to stay ahead of competitors.

Political Science and International Relations: Prepare for careers in government, global trade and politics with expert-led study. Gain the knowledge and skills to navigate complex political and international landscapes.

Real Estate and Property Development: Develop specialist knowledge in finance, law, project management and negotiation for the property sector. Learn from industry collaborations to succeed in Australia's dynamic property market.

Sport Management: Turn your passion for sport into a career by developing business and management skills for sporting organisations. Gain hands-on experience to lead professional and not-for-profit clubs locally and internationally.

You may also choose to minor in:

Tourism Data Analytics (not offered from 2027): Learn to harness data for smarter decision-making in tourism and hospitality. Gain hands-on experience with analytics tools, e-commerce platforms and business intelligence systems to analyse trends and improve customer experiences.

description:
Gain a critical understanding of disability

Strengthen your understanding of the diverse experiences, needs and perspectives of people with disability in this graduate certificate. You will explore historical and contemporary views and first-person narratives on disability to work alongside people with disabilities and understand their perspectives more effectively, placing their lived experienced at the centre of your understanding and practice. This program is guided by inclusion and civil rights and the knowledge that disability is just one influence shaping people's lives.

You will explore policy, program, service and practice issues such as the history and purpose of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS); global and Australian historical and contemporary responses to disability rights; contemporary case-management and person-centred approaches to service delivery; and the development of inclusive practices that value lived experiences and meet the diverse needs of all Australians with a disability.

Industry and expert connections

You will be immersed in accounts of the lived experiences of people with a disability, gaining insight from the insider perspective and examining personal narratives including memoirs, autobiographies and documentary films of, or by, people with a disability. It's this perspective that is crucial to delivering patient-centred services such as health and education to people with a disability. Working alongside student-peers, you'll engage with these topics in seminars, online forums and through groupwork under the supervision of some of Australia's leading academics in this field.

Graduate outcomes

This is an attractive credential if you are already working with, or wish to work with, people with disability in a range of fields including rehabilitation, human services, disability support, health, and disability and health insurance. People from a range of professions benefit from the lessons of this degree, from nurses, doctors, teachers, social workers, carers, and many more.

Flexibility

Study anytime, anywhere - This degree is available online through our Digital campus, giving you more room to fit university with your work and social life.

description:
Some courses in this program are scheduled to be offered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations.

Launch a future-focused career in one of the world's most technology-driven industries with the Bachelor of Aviation/Bachelor of Information Technology. This double degree combines Australia's most highly awarded aviation program with in-demand IT skills, preparing you for a broad range of roles that drive innovation, safety and operational excellence across the aviation sector.

You'll explore key concepts in aviation including navigation, safety systems, and human factors, while gaining deep technical knowledge in information systems, programming, data analytics and more.

Whether you want to build next-generation flight systems, analyse aviation data, or manage secure air traffic technologies, this double degree provides the necessary versatility and skills.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Aviation/Bachelor of Information Technology    
  • Graduate with two sought-after qualifications, blending advanced IT training with applied aviation knowledge.
  • Study aviation operations, air navigation, meteorology, flight planning, human performance, databases, programming and cyber security.
  • Build skills in computational simulations, data analytics, and digital system management using the latest industry-standard tools.
  • Gain practical experience in information technology through a professional work placement aligned to your career goals.
  • Get involved in aviation and IT student clubs to build networks and strengthen your career connections.
Access aviation and IT facilities, including advanced flight simulators and computing labs

Learn in purpose-built aviation and IT labs that bring your studies to life. In the Flight Procedures Laboratory, you'll use real flight controls and simulation software to practise navigation, aircraft systems and flight planning. In our advanced IT facilities, including the Networking Labs and Big Data and Smart Analytics Lab, you'll develop hands-on skills in cyber security, cloud infrastructure, data analysis and intelligent systems. These experiences give you the practical edge to step confidently into both aviation and IT careers.

Shape the future of aviation through innovation and technology

From aviation technology development and air traffic analytics to aviation security and systems integration, this double degree positions you to influence the critical digital infrastructure that keeps modern aviation running safely and efficiently. You'll be prepared to lead digital transformation across commercial, defence, regulatory and airport sectors.

Majors
Networks and cyber security

Develop the expertise to design, manage and secure modern networks and digital systems. Learn core networking principles, cloud architecture, and secure software development. In Australia, professional accreditation of entry to practice engineering programs is the responsibility of Engineers Australia.

Accreditation ensures academic institutions consistently meet national and international benchmarks and engineering graduates of an accredited program are assured membership with Engineers Australia at the relevant career grade and enjoy reciprocal privileges by equivalent professional bodies overseas.

Countries such as the United States of America, United Kingdom, Hong Kong (SAR), New Zealand, Canada, South Africa and others that are co-signatories to international agreements on joint recognition offer international recognition.

The Washington Accord, the Sydney Accord and the Dublin Accord recognise the substantial equivalence of accreditation systems and accredited programs across international boundaries at the Professional Engineer, Engineering Technologist and Engineering Associate levels respectively. Please refer to the International Engineering Alliance (IEA) website for more details.

description:
Advance your expertise in maternity care. Designed for experienced clinicians, this graduate certificate equips you with the knowledge and leadership skills to contribute to emerging, evidence-based models of care that place women and families at the centre of the maternity experience.

Please note: Successful completion of this program does not lead to eligibility to apply for registration as a midwife. Prospective students seeking registration should refer to the Bachelor of Midwifery (1354).

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Primary Maternity Care
  • Develop an advanced understanding of the philosophy and principles that underpin primary maternity care.
  • Explore innovative and sustainable models of maternity service design used across Australia and internationally.
  • Learn from experts and researchers driving reform in maternity care and policy development.
  • Strengthen skills to deliver culturally safe and equitable care in partnership with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.
  • Build the prescribing knowledge and skills required for midwives and meet the education requirement for NMBA endorsement for scheduled medicines (endorsement application required separately).
Build the skills to lead and transform care 

Through courses in leadership and healthcare transformation, you'll enhance your ability to drive innovation and lead positive change in maternity care. By examining new approaches to service delivery, you'll graduate with the confidence to design, evaluate and implement best-practice maternity models that promote continuity of care and improved outcomes for women and families.

Work across communities 

Our coursework is grounded in evidence-based models that emphasise cultural safety, social justice and community responsiveness. This means you'll graduate prepared to deliver tailored maternity care across a range of settings - from urban hospitals and private practices to rural, remote and Indigenous communities.

description:
Queensland's #1 university for electrical and electronic engineering. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Build a powerful combination of engineering knowledge and scientific expertise. This double degree gives you the tools to understand how the world works at every level, from the physical forces that underpin technology to the biological and environmental systems shaping our future.

You'll learn to think creatively, analyse complex problems and apply scientific precision to engineering challenges, while gaining hands-on experience solving real industry problems. You'll also develop the skills to work with emerging technologies such as AI, using data, modelling and intelligent tools to support innovation and solve complex challenges. You'll study with leading experts in world-class facilities and experience practical learning in unique natural environments on our living lab campuses.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)/Bachelor of Science
  • Learn by doing through lab work, unique field experiences, design studios, research and hands-on projects, building practical skills from day one that employers value most.
  • Use digital and AI-enabled tools alongside traditional scientific and engineering methods to analyse information, test ideas and improve solutions.
  • Build a strong foundation in mathematical, physical, biological and environmental sciences alongside advanced engineering theory. Apply this through industry placements, consulting projects and our Industry Affiliates Program, supported by Griffith's strong industry and research connections.
  • Develop the analytical and data skills needed to work confidently in technology-driven industries where AI and automation are part of professional practice.
  • Shape your degree your way by tailoring engineering and science majors to match your interests and career goals, with a flexible degree structure that allows you to switch or combine majors as your interests evolve.
  • Join active clubs, societies and mentoring programs that connect you with like-minded peers, expand your professional networks and support your success in smaller, supportive learning groups.
  • Expand your global perspective and employability with the potential to join an international field trip, which could contribute to your degree depending on your study plan and structure.
  • With flexible tutorial times, online access to learning resources and multiple trimester intakes, you may be able to tailor your timetable to suit your life, even when studying full-time on campus.
Majors

Engineering majors

  • Civil Engineering
  • Electrical and Electronic Engineering
  • Electronic Engineering
  • Enviromental Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering

Science majors

  • Applied Mathematics
  • Physics
Learn from experts, study with industry

Immerse yourself in practical learning where nature is your classroom, with opportunities to learn in living laboratories and natural environments. You'll learn from academics with strong professional networks across engineering, government, conservation, consulting, technology, manufacturing and research.

Explore how emerging technologies, including AI, are being used across these fields to support data analysis, modelling, research and engineering design. Collaborate with professionals and gain more than 400 hours of practical experience. In your final year, you'll take part in an industry placement or capstone project, giving you the confidence to step into complex roles in Australia or internationally.

description:
Become an aviation industry expert with a Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management. Designed for aspiring and working aviation professionals, this qualification strengthens your management capability, commercial insight and operational knowledge in one of the world's most highly regulated sectors.

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management
  • Develop foundational knowledge in aviation management, airport operations and industry governance.
  • Learn practical skills in aviation marketing, planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Understand how to use safety science to enhance the organisation's safety performance in safety-critical environments.
  • Get first-hand insights from industry-informed academics and guest lecturers with aviation experience and learn how airports and aviation organisations are run.
  • Graduate in just six months with full-time study.
A strong foundation in aviation management

Explore the complex commercial, operational and management environment of the aviation sector, from airline management to airport planning and regulation. Foundation courses introduce aviation management principles: leadership, technology, safety and risk management, cost structures and global competition. As a graduate, you'll be able to apply your knowledge, analyse markets, position services and use data to inform strategic business decisions.

Pathway to further study

Whether you're looking to advance your career, transition into the aviation industry or specialise further with the Master of Aviation Management (5776), this graduate certificate sets out a pathway into postgraduate aviation study, with completed courses often credited toward the full masters degree.

The EmpowerED University Preparation Program is a free, fully online, self-paced program that provides a flexible pathway for applicants who don't meet the admission requirements for an undergraduate degree at Griffith. EmpowerED allows you to experience university, build confidence, and develop essential academic skills-all while studying at your own pace, anytime, anywhere.

In EmpowerED, you'll gain essential knowledge-including critical reading, writing, and referencing-within a supportive and dynamic online learning environment. The program sets you up for success through compulsory content covering university preparation, academic study skills, communication, research, maths, and science essentials with an overarching focus on preparing you for future career, including the opportunity to craft a personalised employability plan.

Despite being fully online, you will never feel alone. EmpowerED offers strong student support, interactive online activities and dedicated academic assistance to keep you engaged and motivated.

If you're ready to take the next step toward university, EmpowerED is your bridge to success-built with you in mind, to help you thrive in a flexible, supportive, and technology-enhanced environment.

This program is part of Griffith GO, our 100% online, on-demand degrees that let you start when you're ready, study at your own pace and learn from anywhere.

Future-proof your career with a double degree in information technology and business. This powerful combination gives you the technical skills to develop innovative digital solutions and the business acumen to drive strategic decisions in a connected world.

Build expertise in your chosen IT major while gaining strong foundations in areas such as management, marketing, finance or entrepreneurship. This double degree gives you the versatility to work across industries and disciplines, equipping you to lead projects, launch start-ups or bridge the gap between technical and executive teams.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Information Technology/Bachelor of Business
  • Graduate with two in-demand qualifications with just one extra year of study.
  • Specialise in an IT major and pair it with a business major to create a unique skillset tailored to your goals.
  • Gain experience through internships, including opportunities with government, start-ups and large corporations. For example, you could work on live client projects through the App Factory and develop business-ready software solutions.
  • Learn in industry-grade labs including the Cyber Range, Cisco Networking Lab and Big Data Visualisation Lab.
  • Flexible study options with intakes in Trimester 1, 2 and 3.
A degree with the flexibility to shape your future

This double degree opens the door to a broad range of careers, from Business Analyst and IT Consultant to Product Manager, entrepreneur or CIO. You'll graduate with an edge in today's job market, equipped to lead, innovate and adapt as technology and business continue to evolve.

Learn from academics and industry leaders

Your studies are shaped by expert researchers and professionals at the forefront of digital transformation, cyber security, AI and strategic business. With input from our Industry Advisory Board, including partners like Suncorp and IBM, your learning stays relevant and connected to what employers want. From day one, you'll build both a professional portfolio and a powerful network that supports your success long after graduation.

Majors

Information technology majors
Networks and cyber security

Develop the expertise to design, manage and secure modern networks and digital systems. You'll learn core networking principles, cloud architecture and secure software development, while building practical skills in ethical hacking, digital forensics and enterprise network configuration. Throughout your studies, you'll explore security best practices, threat detection and system hardening to help organisations defend against emerging cyber threats. Graduate ready for in-demand careers in cyber security, network engineering and cloud infrastructure.

Software development

Gain the skills to design and build high-quality software solutions across a range of platforms. You'll learn object-oriented programming, algorithms and software architecture to create robust, scalable applications, and explore full-stack web and mobile development using modern frameworks and tools. Your studies will also take you into interactive environments through game and XR development, where you'll apply user-centred design principles to build engaging, intuitive experiences. Graduate ready to excel in software engineering and application development.

Data analytics and IoT (Internet of Things)

You'll be equipped with the knowledge and skills to harness big data and smart technologies to drive innovation. Explore data analytics techniques, including data mining, modelling, and social media analysis, to extract insights from complex datasets. description:
The Graduate Certificate in Leadership and Business Management helps experienced professionals strengthen their leadership capability and prepare for career advancement. Designed for managers without an undergraduate degree, it builds essential business knowledge and provides a direct pathway into the Master of Business Administration. 

The program is delivered 100% online and on demand, giving you complete control over when and how you study. With no timetables or campus requirements, you can start at any time, progress at your own pace, and access course materials, interactive resources and support whenever you need them. This flexibility allows you to balance study with work and life while still benefiting from a structured, supported learning experience. 

You'll explore what effective leadership looks like today through a focus on responsible leadership, sustainable business practice, and global awareness. This lens helps you sharpen your decision-making, deepen your understanding of strategy and economics, and develop the ability to create long-term value for your organisation and community. 

You'll apply contemporary management concepts directly to challenges from your own workplace, ensuring your learning is practical and immediately relevant. Throughout the program, you'll build a strong understanding of how teams operate, learn how to lift performance through effective leadership, and strengthen your creative problem-solving skills. You'll be equipped to turn ideas into action, lead change with confidence and guide your organisation through periods of transformation. 

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Leadership and Business Management 

  • Study 100% online, on demand. Start when you're ready, set your own pace and pause if you need to. 
  • Flexible pathways - progress at your own pace and tailor your learning journey to your career goals. 
  • Build core skills in accounting, marketing, and economics - taught through the lens of embedding sustainable business practices and social responsibility. 
  • Learn how to hone your skills in leading high impact teams, balancing performance with wellbeing and long-term success. 
  • Explore sustainability and systems thinking, and find how to integrate ethical, adaptive and resilient practices into organisational strategy. 
  • Gain access to a pathway into the Griffith MBA, one of Australia's most respected business leadership programs. 

This degree is part of Griffith GO, our 100% online, on-demand degrees that let you start when you're ready, study at your own pace and learn from anywhere.

Queensland's #1 university for law and criminology. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2026)

Bring together the power of legal knowledge and the influence of modern communication. With this double degree, you'll build a strong foundation in legal practice while gaining the writing, media and strategic communication skills to engage audiences. Whether you're interested in advocacy, journalism, policy, digital media or social justice, this degree prepares you to navigate complex issues and graduate with confidence in fields where communication is the key to success.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Laws (Honours)/Bachelor of Communication
  • Develop in-depth knowledge of core legal areas including crime, contracts, property, torts, corporate law, ethics and Indigenous and international perspectives.
  • Gain practical legal experience from your first year through moots, court visits, industry networking and real client work with the Griffith Legal Clinic program.
  • Build advanced communication skills in digital media production, professional writing, storytelling and content creation.
  • Learn in industry-standard media studios and gain experience through student newsrooms, media projects and communication initiatives.
  • Benefit from strong industry connections, internships and partnerships across media, government, corporate, community and legal sectors.
Where law meets communication

In your law studies, you'll learn from practising legal educators, judges in residence and industry professionals while gaining a deep understanding of the role law plays in society. Your communication studies will give you the ability to craft messages that inform, persuade and empower through a range of media platforms. Together, these qualifications prepare you for career paths that require both legal insight and communication expertise.

Majors
Communication majors

Journalism: Build core reporting and writing skills across print, digital and broadcast platforms, from hard news to long-form features. You'll explore investigative techniques, global reporting and human rights journalism, gaining experience with tools like data visualisation, Freedom of Information processes and multimedia storytelling. With a focus on ethical, solutions-driven reporting, this major prepares you for a dynamic media landscape, whether in traditional newsrooms, digital media or independent journalism.

Strategic Communication: Learn how to shape messages that influence, engage and inspire. This major prepares you to craft persuasive, ethical communication across industries, from media relations and public campaigns to health, crisis and entertainment communication. You'll gain practical experience developing strategy, managing media and responding to real scenarios including political campaigns and emergency events. Whether you're promoting a brand, managing reputation or navigating public discourse, you'll be equipped with the skills to lead communication in an evolving media landscape.

description:
This degree supports Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander students to develop the knowledge, skills and ethics needed to pursue a career as a professional artist or designer. Guided by Indigenous knowledges and values, this degree encourages experimentation with a range of visual mediums and materials that speak to the Indigenous experience within contemporary Australia. A key priority of this degree is cultural leadership, integrity, and community, where you'll develop a comprehensive understanding of cultural ethics and protocols to navigate your creative practice and the contemporary arts sector.

You can choose elective courses in:

  • painting
  • photography
  • sculpture, performance and installation
  • visual communication design
  • product and user experience design
  • interior design
  • drawing
  • jewellery. 
Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Contemporary Australian Indigenous Art (CAIA)
  • The only Indigenous visual arts degree delivered by First Nations staff for First Nations students.
  • Our Indigenous staff are practicing visual artists, designers and researchers.
  • The foundation of the CAIA degree is anchored by your family connections, histories and traditions. This framework supports you to conduct research into your family history and provide maintenance to cultural knowledge.
  • Focus on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander art, media, styles and forms, together with strategies for working as an artist in the contemporary arts sector.
  • This degree intersects and supports engagement across the visual arts and design degrees at the Queensland College of Art and Design (QCAD).

Diploma

The Diploma of Contemporary Australian Indigenous Art (8080) is a pathway program that provides foundational skills in a range of visual art and design practices. This 1-year, full-time diploma encourages experimentation with a range of visual media that speak to the Indigenous experience within contemporary Australia, in a supportive learning environment.

The diploma provides a practical foundation to explore the university experience without an initial commitment to a longer degree. Graduates of the diploma can continue their studies in the Bachelor of Contemporary Australian Indigenous Art.
