description:
Today's discoveries in the biomolecular sciences lead to tomorrow's applications in fields ranging from medicine and healthcare to food, agriculture, environmental protection and the biotechnology industries.

Biomolecular science is the most rapidly developing area in science at the crossroads of the biological, chemical, physical and computational sciences that are driving the current extraordinary advances across biotechnology and medicine. It encompasses chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, the new genetics, genetic engineering, genomics and proteomics, structural and systems biology and bioinformatics.

This advanced program is designed to train a new generation of biomolecular scientists to meet industry requirements for professional, workplace ready, research-ready graduates with high-level expertise and skill.

The program gives you a unique opportunity to be immersed in cutting-edge research during your undergraduate studies, with the flexibility to undertake a fourth year level research track, or to exit after successful completion of third year level with a Bachelor of Biomolecular Science.

description:
If you are looking to progress your career in the fast-paced, high-growth area of IT and computer science, this qualification, designed specifically to upskill women in the workforce, will set you on your path in just two years part-time study.

This degree gives you the opportunity to establish and progress a career in critical future roles in computing, data analytics, and cyber security, and addresses skill shortages in these areas.  The program has a practical, problem-solving approach in its delivery where students are taken through a journey of requirement analysis, system design, implementation and evaluation, focusing on practical problems. Regular guest speakers from a range of industries providing broad exposure to IT opportunities are incorporated in this flexibly delivered program. As a female-only cohort of students, the program is designed to ease some of the barriers women face entering the technology sector.

Upon successful completion, you may be eligible to apply for a bachelor level degree specialising Computer Science or Information Technology and may also receive credit towards your degree.

With this qualification, you'll gain an integrated understanding of catchment function and the right mix of hydrological and hydraulic computer modelling and data science skills needed to further a career in catchment hydrology and water management.

You'll develop a critical and applied understanding of catchment hydrological, ecological, and morphological processes and how they inter-relate.

Industry and expert connections

You'll get exclusive access to expert lecturers and experienced industry speakers and participate in practical workshops and field trips. You can also stay close to industry experts with one-on-one career mentoring.

Graduate outcomes

You'll be equipped with the skills and knowledge needed to work in areas of Catchment Management and Wastewater Treatment in regulatory agencies, local and state government authorities, environmental consulting companies, and non-government organisations.

You can also choose to continue your studies through our Master of Catchment Science or Master of Integrated Water Management degrees.

description:
Discover how powerful storytelling, strategic messaging and evidence-based decision-making come together to influence public debate and drive meaningful reform. The Bachelor of Communication/Master of Public Policy and Leadership is a vertical degree designed for ambitious students who want to combine expertise in digital media, journalism or strategic communication with advanced knowledge in public policy and public sector leadership.

Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Communication/Master of Public Policy and Leadership
  • Graduate with both a bachelors and masters degree in just four years, accelerating your progression into influential roles across government, media and not-for-profits.
  • Develop advanced writing, multimedia production and digital communication skills across platforms including emerging technologies.
  • Build expertise in strategic communication, media relations and public campaigns, with a strong focus on ethics and social responsibility.
  • Learn how public policy is designed, implemented and evaluated in complex political and organisational environments.
  • Strengthen your capabilities in policy analysis, program evaluation, stakeholder engagement and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Gain hands-on experience through internships, industry collaborations, real case studies and professional networking.
Communication expertise that influences policy

In the Bachelor of Communication, you'll immerse yourself in the contemporary communication and media landscape. Whether you major in journalism or strategic communication, you'll learn how to craft persuasive messages, analyse audiences, manage reputation and communicate with clarity in high-stakes environments. You'll build a professional portfolio using industry-standard studios and technologies, while developing the critical thinking and creativity needed to navigate media, politics and public discourse.

Move seamlessly into the Master of Public Policy and Leadership, where you'll deepen your understanding of public administration, governance and leadership. Explore policy analysis, impact evaluation, regulation, integrity and strategic planning while learning how institutions operate at local, national and global levels. Taught by leading researchers and experienced practitioners, this degree prepares you to lead with credibility, insight and accountability.

description:
Transform your clinical role and meet the evolving needs of the Australian healthcare system.Building on your existing clinical foundation, you'll develop the high-level diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning required for safe, effective prescribing.

This program is specifically designed for Ahpra general registered pharmacists looking to extend beyond medication management to prescribing and expanded scope. 

Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Advanced Pharmacy Practice and Prescribing:
  • Master advanced clinical assessment and diagnostic techniques. 
  • Refine clinical decision-making and communication skills to support person-centred management of acute and chronic conditions for patients with simple and complex care needs. 
  • Apply critical thinking and ethical principles to the use of digital platforms including artificial intelligence (AI) and clinical software. 
  • Engage in inter-professional learning for seamless integration into multidisciplinary teams. 
  • Simulated and real-world learning and assessment including clinical supervised practice to build capability and practice readiness. Simulated learning will include use of digitally innovative platforms, AI agents, and healthcare tools. 
What to expect
  • Flexible on demand learning with 24/7 access to support.
  • High-quality online learning developed by prescribers and learning designers with input from consumers.
  • Practical in-person learning that builds confidence and capability with real life scenarios and patients.
  • Opportunities for interprofessional learning with diverse prescribers and health professional colleagues building these capabilities.
Flexible learning for expanded practice

Study via flexible online self-paced modules created by clinical and educational experts, combined with in-person training experiences with prescribers, industry leaders, health consumers and other health professionals. Stay on track with dedicated academic assistance and strong student support.

With your deeper knowledge of digital health and innovation you'll be prepared to confidently step into expanded scope roles.

This degree is part of Griffith GO, our 100% online, on-demand degrees that let you start when you're ready, study at your own pace and learn from anywhere.

description:
The EmpowerED for School Leavers provides a flexible pathway for applicants who don't meet the formal entry requirements for an undergraduate degree at Griffith. If you're enrolled in Year 12 and considering university after high school but haven't chosen an ATAR pathway or are unsure if you'll meet the requirements to get into university, this version of EmpowerED is for you. 

With this fast-tracked program, you can complete your studies in time to start an undergraduate Griffith degree by Trimester 1.

As a free preparatory pathway, you'll have the opportunity to build your confidence and academic study skills in an online, fully self-paced environment through on-demand content - giving you more flexibility to learn in a way that works for you from anywhere, any time.  

You'll gain fundamental knowledge and skills including the essentials of critical reading, writing and referencing, in a supportive learning environment. In addition to these fundamental skills, you'll explore your career aspirations and gain confidence in maths essentials preparing you for university and beyond. 

From start to finish, EmpowerED for School Leavers offers strong student support, valuable learning experiences and dedicated academic assistance to keep you engaged and motivated. Plus, when you complete the program, you'll be guaranteed entry to a range of undergraduate Griffith degrees from Trimester 1 2027 (subject to entry requirements).  

If you're ready to start your journey to uni, EmpowerED for School Leavers is your pathway to achieving your academic and personal goals. 

This degree is part of Griffith GO, our 100% online, on-demand degrees that let you start when you're ready, study at your own pace and learn from anywhere.
